title: Structural biology of the dengue virus NS2B-NS3 protease as a target for antiviral drug development.
abstract: Dengue is the most common global problem in recent times, particularly in tropical and subtropical areas, yet antivirals for therapy or prophylaxis are lacking. Millions of people are affected by this dengue virus, but no proper medication is available yet to cure this disease. One polyprotein that is encoded by the DENV genome is converted into structural and non-structural proteins that are necessary for viral pathogenesis and replication. Among these, the non-structural protein complex NS2B-NS3 is essential for viral polyprotein processing, replication, and host innate immune response control. It acts as a trypsin-like serine protease. The NS2B/NS3 protease is a key enzyme involved in viral replication and serves as a major target for drug development against the dengue virus. The NS3 protease has a conserved catalytic triad (His-Asp-Ser), whereas NS2B serves as an essential cofactor that stabilizes the active conformation of the enzyme and aids in substrate recognition. By disrupting interferon signalling pathways, the NS2B-NS3 protease not only aids in viral replication but also makes immune evasion easier. The compound that inhibits the action of this enzyme could be pioneering in the antiviral drug discovery process. This article provides a comprehensive overview of the detailed structural information of the viral protease (NS2B/NS3) enzyme with the mechanistic role of this enzyme, and highlights various inhibitors related to the NS2B/NS3 protease. A more thorough comprehension of this protease could facilitate the logical development of potent antiviral medications to prevent dengue infection.

title: The varying neuroradiological manifestations of pediatric dengue central nervous system infection: a pictorial review from Pakistan with literature correlation.
abstract: Dengue infection is an increasingly recognized cause of neurological complications in children, with a wide and evolving spectrum of central and peripheral nervous system involvement. This pictorial review systematically illustrates the neuroradiological manifestations of pediatric dengue using a pathophysiology- and imaging pattern-based approach, correlating characteristic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) findings with the current literature. Neuroimaging manifestations are broadly categorized into direct viral neuroinvasive, immune-mediated, and reversible edema patterns. Direct viral involvement includes meningoencephalitis, deep gray matter involvement, and rhombencephalitis, with severe cases demonstrating the characteristic "double doughnut" sign of necrotizing encephalopathy-like encephalitis and the "Jack-o'-lantern" sign of pontine involvement. Immune-mediated white matter injury includes acute leukoencephalopathy with restricted diffusion and acute disseminated encephalomyelitis, which differ in their diffusion characteristics and temporal relationship to infection. Reversible edema syndromes include reversible splenial lesion syndrome and the less commonly reported posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome, both associated with favorable clinical and radiological outcomes. Spinal and peripheral nervous system manifestations include myelitis and Guillain-Barré syndrome, with MRI playing a key role in differentiating these entities from other infectious and inflammatory myeloradiculopathies. abstract_zh: 登革热感染是儿童神经系统并发症的一个日益被认识的原因,其累及中枢和周围神经系统的范围广泛且不断演变。这篇图片综述使用基于病理生理学和成像模式的方法系统地说明了儿科登革热的神经放射学表现,并将特征性磁共振成像 (MRI) 结果与当前文献相关联。神经影像学表现大致分为直接病毒神经侵袭性、免疫介导性和可逆性水肿模式。病毒直接累及包括脑膜脑炎、深部灰质累及和菱形脑炎,严重病例表现出坏死性脑病样脑炎的特征性“双甜甜圈”征象和脑桥受累的“南瓜灯”征象。免疫介导的白质损伤包括扩散受限的急性白质脑病和急性播散性脑脊髓炎,它们的扩散特征和与感染的时间关系不同。可逆性水肿综合征包括可逆性压部病变综合征和较少报道的可逆性后部脑病综合征,两者都与良好的临床和放射学结果相关。脊髓和周围神经系统表现包括脊髓炎和吉兰-巴利综合征,MRI 在区分这些实体与其他感染性和炎症性脊髓神经根病方面发挥着关键作用。重要的是,磁敏感加权或梯度回忆回波成像的病灶内出血性变化,特别是在深灰核和脑干内,代表了一种有价值的成像标记,有利于登革热而不是几种病毒和炎症模拟物。识别这些基于特征模式的神经放射学表现及其潜在的病理生理学相关性可以提高诊断信心,促进与竞争性诊断的区分,并指导流行地区儿科登革热神经系统疾病的及时管理。

title: Applying a multiplex electrochemiluminescence NS1 assay to detect and differentiate Zika and dengue virus exposures in long-term community cohorts in Brazil and Thailand
abstract: Background: Distinguishing Zika virus (ZIKV) from dengue virus (DENV) infection remains a major diagnostic challenge in co-endemic regions due to antigenic cross-reactivity. We evaluated a multiplex electrochemiluminescence Meso Scale Discovery System (MSD) NS1 assay to define ZIKV infection with high specificity across diverse immune backgrounds. Methods: We analyzed longitudinal samples from PCR-confirmed ZIKV and DENV infections across multiple cohorts, assessed correlations between MSD NS1 signal intensities and PRNT50 titres, and performed ROC analyses to derive seroconversion thresholds. We then applied these criteria to identify ZIKV seroconversions in Brazil (2015-2024) and Thailand (2015-2025). Findings: ZIKV infections produced sustained NS1 responses, whereas primary DENV infections showed minimal ZIKV cross-reactivity and secondary DENV infections exhibited only transient, low-level increases. MSD NS1 signal intensities correlated with PRNT50 titres for ZIKV and all four DENV serotypes (rho = 0.54-0.84). ROC analyses identified a fold-change of at least 10.96 as the optimal ZIKV seroconversion cutoff, with an AUC of 100% among DENV-naive and 90.7% among DENV-exposed participants. Adding a second criterion - ZIKV/DENV fold-change ratio > 1 - further increased specificity. Application of this dual-threshold framework revealed high ZIKV incidence during the 2015-2016 epidemic in Brazil and very low incidence in the post-epidemic period. In the Thailand cohort, synchronous seroconversion among household members suggested potential intra-household transmission. Interpretation: The MSD NS1 multiplex assay provides a scalable, quantitative, and highly specific approach for identifying ZIKV infection and estimating seroincidence in co-endemic settings. The dual-threshold framework (fold-change of at least 10.96 and ZIKV/DENV ratio > 1) enhances diagnostic precision, offering a robust tool for surveillance and transmission studies in flavivirus-endemic regions.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to address the diagnostic challenge of distinguishing Zika virus (ZIKV) from dengue virus (DENV) infections in co-endemic regions. The researchers evaluated a multiplex electrochemiluminescence assay to define ZIKV infection with high specificity across diverse immune backgrounds. They analyzed longitudinal samples from PCR-confirmed ZIKV and DENV infections in Brazil and Thailand, correlating MSD NS1 signal intensities with PRNT50 titres and performing ROC analyses to establish seroconversion thresholds. The results showed that ZIKV infections produced sustained NS1 responses, while primary DENV infections had minimal cross-reactivity and secondary DENV infections showed only transient, low-level increases. The MSD NS1 assay demonstrated high specificity, with an AUC of 100% among DENV-naive individuals and 90.7% among DENV-exposed participants. Adding a second criterion - ZIKV/DENV fold-change ratio > 1 - further improved specificity. The dual-threshold framework revealed high ZIKV incidence during the 2015-2016 epidemic in Brazil and very low incidence in the post-epidemic period. The study suggests that this assay could be a valuable tool for surveillance and transmission studies in flavivirus-endemic regions. However, the evidence is limited to the specific context of ZIKV and DENV, and the results may not be generalizable to other flaviviruses.

title_zh: 应用多重电化学发光 NS1 测定法检测和区分巴西和泰国 队列研究 长期社区中的寨卡病毒和 登革病毒 暴露情况
source_body_en: Background: Distinguishing Zika virus (ZIKV) from dengue virus (DENV) infection remains a major diagnostic challenge in co-endemic regions due to antigenic cross-reactivity. We evaluated a multiplex electrochemiluminescence Meso Scale Discovery System (MSD) NS1 assay to define ZIKV infection with high specificity across diverse immune backgrounds. Methods: We analyzed longitudinal samples from PCR-confirmed ZIKV and DENV infections across multiple cohorts, assessed correlations between MSD NS1 signal intensities and PRNT50 titres, and performed ROC analyses to derive seroconversion thresholds. We then applied these criteria to identify ZIKV seroconversions in Brazil (2015-2024) and Thailand (2015-2025). Findings: ZIKV infections produced sustained NS1 responses, whereas primary DENV infections showed minimal ZIKV cross-reactivity and secondary DENV infections exhibited only transient, low-level increases. MSD NS1 signal intensities correlated with PRNT50 titres for ZIKV and all four DENV serotypes (rho = 0.54-0.84). ROC analyses identified a fold-change of at least 10.96 as the optimal ZIKV seroconversion cutoff, with an AUC of 100% among DENV-naive and 90.7% among DENV-exposed participants. Adding a second criterion - ZIKV/DENV fold-change ratio > 1 - further increased specificity. Application of this dual-threshold framework revealed high ZIKV incidence during the 2015-2016 epidemic in Brazil and very low incidence in the post-epidemic period. In the Thailand cohort, synchronous seroconversion among household members suggested potential intra-household transmission. Interpretation: The MSD NS1 multiplex assay provides a scalable, quantitative, and highly specific approach for identifying ZIKV infection and estimating seroincidence in co-endemic settings. The dual-threshold framework (fold-change of at least 10.96 and ZIKV/DENV ratio > 1) enhances diagnostic precision, offering a robust tool for surveillance and transmission studies in flavivirus-endemic regions.

title: Evaluating the Suitability of Dengue Viraemia as a Surrogate Efficacy Outcome for Phase III Trials of Dengue Antivirals: A Systematic Review
abstract: Abstract Background: Dengue cases reached record levels in 2024 alongside geographic expansion into Europe and Africa. The low rate of progression to severe dengue presents a challenge for powering phase III dengue antiviral trials. Viraemia is used as a virological outcome in phase II trials, but whether treatment-induced reductions reliably predict clinical benefit remains uncertain. This systematic review assessed the association between dengue viraemia and disease severity and its suitability as a surrogate efficacy outcome for phase III antiviral trials. Methods: We searched Ovid MEDLINE, Ovid Embase, Scopus, and Web of Science on 20 June 2025 for studies indexed since 2017, extending a previous systematic review. We included clinical studies of laboratory-confirmed dengue measuring quantitative serum viral load by RT-PCR at enrolment and at least one subsequent timepoint and reporting severe dengue as a clinical outcome. The review was registered with PROSPERO (CRD420251077148) and followed PRISMA 2020 reporting guidelines. Results: We screened 3303 records and reviewed 60 full texts; 11 studies met the inclusion criteria, comprising predominantly hospitalised paediatric and younger adult cohorts from the Asia-Pacific. Seven studies reported higher early viraemia (typically during illness days 1– 5) in patients with more severe disease, whereas three found no significant association and one provided insufficient evidence. Two studies assessing viraemia kinetics found that faster viral clearance was associated with lower risk of severe dengue. Heterogeneity in sampling timing, severity classification, and adjustment for host and viral factors limited interpretation. Certainty of evidence was very low. Conclusions: Evidence for an association between dengue viraemia and disease severity was inconsistent and limited by methodological heterogeneity. Most studies assessed severity around the time of hospital admission and could not establish if viraemia predicted subsequent progression from non-severe to severe disease. None were designed to determine whether treatment-induced reductions in viraemia translate into clinical benefit. Dengue viraemia should therefore be regarded as a pharmacodynamic biomarker and supportive virological outcome for early-phase antiviral development, rather than as a validated surrogate efficacy outcome for phase III trials, for which clinically meaningful patient-centred outcomes remain necessary.

Viraemia is used as a virological outcome in phase II trials, but whether treatment-induced reductions reliably predict clinical benefit remains uncertain. This systematic review assessed the association between dengue viraemia and disease severity and its suitability as a surrogate efficacy outcome for phase III antiviral trials. Methods: We searched Ovid MEDLINE, Ovid Embase, Scopus, and Web of Science on 20 June 2025 for studies indexed since 2017, extending a previous systematic review. We included clinical studies of laboratory-confirmed dengue measuring quantitative serum viral load by RT-PCR at enrolment and at least one subsequent timepoint and reporting severe dengue as a clinical outcome. The review was registered with PROSPERO (CRD420251077148) and followed PRISMA 2020 reporting guidelines. Results: We screened 3303 records and reviewed 60 full texts; 11 studies met the inclusion criteria, comprising predominantly hospitalised paediatric and younger adult cohorts from the Asia-Pacific. Seven studies reported higher early viraemia (typically during illness days 1– 5) in patients with more severe disease, whereas three found no significant association and one provided insufficient evidence. Two studies assessing viraemia kinetics found that faster viral clearance was associated with lower risk of severe dengue. Heterogeneity in sampling timing, severity classification, and adjustment for host and viral factors limited interpretation. Certainty of evidence was very low. Conclusions: Evidence for an association between dengue viraemia and disease severity was inconsistent and limited by methodological heterogeneity. Most studies assessed severity around the time of hospital admission and could not establish if viraemia predicted subsequent progression from non-severe to severe disease. None were designed to determine whether treatment-induced reductions in viraemia translate into clinical benefit. Dengue viraemia should therefore be regarded as a pharmacodynamic biomarker and supportive virological outcome for early-phase antiviral development, rather than as a validated surrogate efficacy outcome for phase III trials, for which clinically meaningful patient-centred outcomes remain necessary.

abstract_zh: 摘要背景:随着地域扩张到欧洲和非洲,登革热病例在 2024 年达到创纪录水平。重症登革热 的低进展率对登革热 III 期 抗病毒药物 试验的支持提出了挑战。病毒血症在 II 期试验中被用作病毒学结果,但 治疗 诱导的减少是否可靠地预测临床益处仍不确定。这项系统评价评估了登革热病毒血症与疾病严重程度之间的关联及其作为 III 期 抗病毒药物 试验的替代疗效结果的适用性。方法:我们于 2025 年 6 月 20 日检索了 Ovid MEDLINE、Ovid Embase、Scopus 和 Web of Science,查找自 2017 年以来编入索引的研究,扩展了之前的系统评价。我们纳入了实验室确诊的登革热临床研究,在入组时和至少一个后续时间点通过 RT-PCR 测量定量血清病毒载量,并报告 重症登革热 作为临床结果。该审查已在 PROSPERO 注册 (CRD420251077148),并遵循 PRISMA 2020 报告指南。结果:筛选3303条记录,审阅全文60篇;11 项研究符合纳入标准,主要包括来自亚太地区的住院儿童和年轻成人 队列研究。七项研究报告称,病情较严重的患者早期病毒血症(通常在患病第 1-5 天期间)较高,而三项研究发现没有显着关联,一项研究提供的证据不足。两项评估病毒血症动力学的研究发现,病毒清除速度越快,重症登革热 风险越低。采样时间、严重程度分类以及 宿主 和病毒因素调整的异质性限制了解释。证据的质量非常低。结论:登革热病毒血症与疾病严重程度之间相关性的证据不一致,并且受到方法学异质性的限制。大多数研究在入院时评估严重程度,无法确定病毒血症是否可以预测随后从非严重疾病进展为严重疾病。没有一个旨在确定 治疗 诱导的病毒血症减少是否转化为临床益处。因此,登革热病毒血症应被视为早期 抗病毒药物 开发的药效生物标志物和支持性病毒学结果,而不是作为 III 期试验的经过验证的替代疗效结果,因为 III 期试验仍需要具有临床意义的以患者为中心的结果。

title: Beyond Hemorrhage: A Case of Acute Dengue Infection Presenting with Budd-Chiari Syndrome and Bilateral Sensory Polyneuropathy.
abstract: Abstract Budd–Chiari syndrome (BCS) is a rare hepatic vascular disorder characterized by hepatic venous outflow obstruction with an incidence of 1–2 per million population annually. While dengue fever is primarily associated with hemorrhagic complications, thrombotic events are rarely reported. To our knowledge, this represents the first documented case of BCS occurring in association with dengue fever. A 22-year-old male from a rural area presented with a 4-day history of abdominal pain, fever, vomiting, and loose stools. Physical examination revealed hepatomegaly, ascites, and mild dehydration. Laboratory investigations confirmed dengue IgM positivity with thrombocytopenia (104,000/mm 3 ) and elevated liver enzymes. Thrombophilia screening revealed deficiencies in protein C, protein S, and antithrombin III. Imaging studies, including ultrasonography, computed tomography with contrast, and color Doppler, demonstrated hepatic vein thrombosis, inferior vena cava narrowing, and caudate lobe hypertrophy, establishing the diagnosis of BCS. Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy revealed grade II esophageal varices consistent with portal hypertension. During admission, the patient also developed severe bilateral lower limb pain refractory to strong analgesics, and nerve conduction studies confirmed sensory polyneuropathy in both lower limbs. The patient was managed with supportive care and careful anticoagulation therapy using low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH), followed by warfarin 4 mg daily. Despite initial thrombocytopenia, anticoagulation was successfully initiated with close monitoring for bleeding complications. The patient showed an excellent clinical response, with complete resolution of hepatic vein thrombosis, normalization of liver function, and resolution of ascites at follow-up. At 6-month follow-up, repeat thrombophilia assays performed after stopping warfarin and bridging with LMWH revealed normal levels of protein C, protein S, and antithrombin III, indicating no true inherited deficiency. This case highlights a novel association between dengue fever, BCS, and sensory polyneuropathy in a patient with apparent but transient thrombophilia. Early recognition, appropriate anticoagulation, and careful neurological evaluation can lead to favorable outcomes despite concurrent thrombocytopenia.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对一名22岁男性患者进行单病例研究,该患者来自农村地区,表现为急性登革病毒感染,伴有腹痛、发热、呕吐和腹泻,同时出现布-奇亚里综合征和感觉性多发性神经病的体征。
elements_zh.methods: 通过实验室检查,包括登革热IgM检测、血小板减少评估和肝酶升高,确认了患者的诊断。利用超声检查、增强型计算机断层扫描和彩色多普勒成像评估肝静脉流出道阻塞。进行了血栓形成倾向筛查以评估凝血因子。
elements_zh.main_results: 患者登革热IgM检测呈阳性,伴有血小板减少(104,000/mm3)和肝酶升高。影像学检查确认了肝静脉血栓形成、下腔静脉狭窄和尾状叶增大,确立了诊断与布-奇亚里综合征的关联。血栓形成倾向筛查显示蛋白C、蛋白S和抗凝血酶III缺乏。患者还出现了严重的双下肢疼痛,神经传导研究证实了双下肢的感觉性多发性神经病。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此病例解释为首次记录的布-奇亚里综合征与登革热相关联的病例,强调了短暂性血栓形成倾向以及布-奇亚里综合征与双侧感觉性多发性神经病的不寻常组合。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该病例为登革病毒感染的非典型临床表现提供了重要见解,特别是与布-奇亚里综合征和感觉性多发性神经病的关联,这可能有助于更广泛的监测和登革热相关并发症的诊断方法。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于单个 病例报告,可能无法推广。然而,证据是强有力的,因为它包括详细的临床、实验室和影像学结果,支持 BCS 的 诊断 和 登革热,并具有明确的时间关系。

The patient also developed severe bilateral lower limb pain and nerve conduction studies confirmed sensory polyneuropathy in both lower limbs.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret this case as the first documented instance of BCS occurring in association with dengue fever, emphasizing the transient thrombophilia and the unusual combination of BCS and bilateral sensory polyneuropathy.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This case provides important insights into the atypical clinical manifestations of dengue infection, particularly the association with BCS and sensory polyneuropathy, which may inform broader surveillance and diagnostic approaches for dengue-related complications.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a single case report, which may not be generalizable. However, the evidence is strong as it includes detailed clinical, laboratory, and imaging findings that support the diagnosis of BCS and dengue fever, with a clear temporal relationship.

title_zh: 超越出血:一例急性登革病毒感染伴发布-奇亚里综合征和双侧感觉性多发性神经病的病例
source_body_en: Abstract Budd–Chiari syndrome (BCS) is a rare hepatic vascular disorder characterized by hepatic venous outflow obstruction with an incidence of 1–2 per million population annually. While dengue fever is primarily associated with hemorrhagic complications, thrombotic events are rarely reported. To our knowledge, this represents the first documented case of BCS occurring in association with dengue fever. A 22-year-old male from a rural area presented with a 4-day history of abdominal pain, fever, vomiting, and loose stools. Physical examination revealed hepatomegaly, ascites, and mild dehydration. Laboratory investigations confirmed dengue IgM positivity with thrombocytopenia (104,000/mm 3 ) and elevated liver enzymes. Thrombophilia screening revealed deficiencies in protein C, protein S, and antithrombin III. Imaging studies, including ultrasonography, computed tomography with contrast, and color Doppler, demonstrated hepatic vein thrombosis, inferior vena cava narrowing, and caudate lobe hypertrophy, establishing the diagnosis of BCS. Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy revealed grade II esophageal varices consistent with portal hypertension. During admission, the patient also developed severe bilateral lower limb pain refractory to strong analgesics, and nerve conduction studies confirmed sensory polyneuropathy in both lower limbs. The patient was managed with supportive care and careful anticoagulation therapy using low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH), followed by warfarin 4 mg daily. Despite initial thrombocytopenia, anticoagulation was successfully initiated with close monitoring for bleeding complications. The patient showed an excellent clinical response, with complete resolution of hepatic vein thrombosis, normalization of liver function, and resolution of ascites at follow-up. At 6-month follow-up, repeat thrombophilia assays performed after stopping warfarin and bridging with LMWH revealed normal levels of protein C, protein S, and antithrombin III, indicating no true inherited deficiency. This case highlights a novel association between dengue fever, BCS, and sensory polyneuropathy in a patient with apparent but transient thrombophilia. Early recognition, appropriate anticoagulation, and careful neurological evaluation can lead to favorable outcomes despite concurrent thrombocytopenia.
abstract_zh: 摘要 布加综合征 (BCS) 是一种罕见的肝血管疾病,其特征是肝静脉流出道阻塞,每年每百万人口中有 1-2 例出现 发病率。虽然 登革热 主要与出血并发症相关,但血栓事件却很少报道。据我们所知,这是第一个有记录的与 登革热 相关的 BCS 病例。一名22岁农村男性因腹痛、发热、呕吐、稀便病史4天就诊。体检发现肝肿大、腹水和轻度脱水。实验室检查证实登革热 IgM 阳性,伴有血小板减少 (104,000/mm 3 ) 和肝酶升高。血栓形成倾向筛查显示蛋白 C、蛋白 S 和抗凝血酶 III 缺乏。影像学研究,包括超声检查、对比计算机断层扫描和彩色多普勒,显示肝静脉血栓形成、下腔静脉狭窄和尾状叶肥大,建立了 BCS 的 诊断。上消化道内镜检查显示II级食管静脉曲张,符合门静脉高压症。入院期间,患者还出现双下肢严重疼痛,强效镇痛药无效,神经传导检查证实双下肢存在感觉性多发性神经病。该患者接受了支持性护理和使用低分子肝素 (LMWH) 的仔细抗凝治疗,随后每天服用 4 mg 华法林。尽管最初出现血小板减少,但通过密切监测出血并发症,成功开始抗凝治疗。该患者表现出良好的临床反应,随访时肝静脉血栓完全消退,肝功能正常化,腹水消退。在 6 个月的随访中,停止华法林并桥接 LMWH 后进行的重复血栓形成倾向检测显示蛋白 C、蛋白 S 和抗凝血酶 III 水平正常,表明不存在真正的遗传缺陷。该病例强调了 登革热、BCS 与患有明显但短暂的血栓形成倾向的患者的感觉多发性神经病之间的新关联。尽管同时存在血小板减少症,但早期识别、适当的抗凝和仔细的神经学评估仍可带来良好的结果。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在记录一种罕见且新颖的关联,即登革热与布-奇亚里综合征(BCS)及双侧感觉性多发性神经病之间的联系,强调识别登革病毒感染非典型表现的重要性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 对一名22岁男性患者进行单病例研究,该患者来自农村地区,表现为急性登革病毒感染,伴有腹痛、发热、呕吐和腹泻,同时出现布-奇亚里综合征和感觉性多发性神经病的体征。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过实验室检查,包括登革热IgM检测、血小板减少评估和肝酶升高,确认了患者的诊断。利用超声检查、增强型计算机断层扫描和彩色多普勒成像评估肝静脉流出道阻塞。进行了血栓形成倾向筛查以评估凝血因子。
analysis_zh.main_results: 患者登革热IgM检测呈阳性,伴有血小板减少(104,000/mm3)和肝酶升高。影像学检查确认了肝静脉血栓形成、下腔静脉狭窄和尾状叶增大,确立了诊断与布-奇亚里综合征的关联。血栓形成倾向筛查显示蛋白C、蛋白S和抗凝血酶III缺乏。患者还出现了严重的双下肢疼痛,神经传导研究证实了双下肢的感觉性多发性神经病。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此病例解释为首次记录的布-奇亚里综合征与登革热相关联的病例,强调了短暂性血栓形成倾向以及布-奇亚里综合征与双侧感觉性多发性神经病的不寻常组合。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该病例为登革病毒感染的非典型临床表现提供了重要见解,特别是与布-奇亚里综合征和感觉性多发性神经病的关联,这可能有助于更广泛的监测和登革热相关并发症的诊断方法。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于单个 病例报告,可能无法推广。然而,证据是强有力的,因为它包括详细的临床、实验室和影像学结果,支持 BCS 的 诊断 和 登革热,并具有明确的时间关系。

title: Clinical Characteristics, Associated Factors, Treatment Practices, and Outcomes of Dengue Fever among Adult Acute Febrile Illness Cases in Las’anod, Sool Region, Somalia: A Hospital-Based Cross-Sectional Study
abstract: Background: Dengue fever is an emerging public health concern in Somalia, but evidence on its clinical presentation, serological test patterns, associated factors, treatment practices, and outcomes among adult acute febrile illness cases remains limited. This study assessed dengue fever among adult acute febrile illness cases in Las’anod, Sool Region, Somalia. Methods A hospital-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 260 adult patients with acute febrile illness assessed for dengue fever at Las’anod General Hospital, Manhal Hospital, and Somali Higher Hospital. Data were collected using a standardized data extraction checklist from patient records, clinical evaluation forms, and laboratory records. Dengue positivity was determined using serology test results. Descriptive statistics, Chi-square tests, binary logistic regression, and multivariable logistic regression were used for analysis. Adjusted odds ratios with 95% confidence intervals were reported, and statistical significance was set at p < 0.05. Results Of the 260 participants, 78 (30.0%) tested positive for dengue serology and 182 (70.0%) tested negative. Among positive cases, 61 (23.5%) were IgM positive only, and 17 (6.5%) were positive for both IgM and NS1. Fever was the most common symptom, reported by 157 (60.38%) participants. Most participants were not admitted to hospital, 229 (88.08%), and 248 (95.38%) survived, while 12 (4.62%) deaths were recorded. In multivariable analysis, age 25–35 years, monthly household income, previous dengue diagnosis, knowledge level, and indoor water storage were significantly associated with dengue positivity. Conclusions Dengue fever was a substantial contributor to acute febrile illness among adults in Las’anod. Strengthening dengue diagnosis, community awareness, safe water storage practices, vector control, and standardized clinical management may improve detection, prevention, and outcomes in resource-limited settings.

title: A gut commensal Serratia marcescens inhibits dengue virus infection via prodigiosin-induced autophagy in Aedes albopictus .
abstract: The mosquito gut microbiota plays a pivotal role in regulating arbovirus transmission, yet the specific antiviral metabolites produced by native symbiotic bacteria and their underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this study, we isolated a natural gut symbiotic bacterium, Serratia marcescens strain WZ1, from field-caught Aedes albopictus in Wenzhou, China, and demonstrated its potent ability to inhibit dengue virus (DENV) infection. Through integrated metabolomic analysis, we identified the red pigment prodigiosin (PG) as a functional antiviral metabolite secreted by this strain. PG treatment suppressed DENV infection in mosquito cells in a dose- and time-dependent manner and significantly reduced DENV2 RNA levels in adult Ae. Mechanistic investigations revealed that PG preferentially localizes to the endoplasmic reticulum (ER), where it induces ER stress and upregulates the chaperone protein GRP78. This process subsequently activates a complete autophagic flux, as evidenced by enhanced conversion of Atg8-I to Atg8-II, increased autophagosome formation, and elevated lysosomal activity. Crucially, we further demonstrated that PG facilitates the convergence of autophagosomes and lysosomes, culminating in the colocalization of DENV with lysosomal compartments and subsequent viral clearance. Both genetic knockdown of the autophagy gene Atg8 and pharmacological inhibition of ER stress substantially attenuated PG-mediated viral suppression, confirming the functional link between PG-induced ER stress, autophagy activation, and viral clearance. Our findings elucidate a novel mechanism by which a native mosquito gut symbiont metabolite restricts arboviral infection through activation of the host ER stress-autophagy pathway, providing a mechanistic basis and candidate leads for future transmission-blocking studies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the role of mosquito gut microbiota in regulating arbovirus transmission, with a focus on identifying specific antiviral metabolites and their mechanisms of action against dengue virus.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved isolating Serratia marcescens strain WZ1 from field-caught Aedes albopictus in Wenzhou, China, and demonstrating its ability to inhibit dengue virus infection. The research was conducted using mosquito cells and adult Ae.
analysis.methods: The researchers performed integrated metabolomic analysis to identify the antiviral metabolite prodigiosin (PG) secreted by Serratia marcescens strain WZ1. They evaluated PG's effects on dengue virus infection through dose- and time-dependent assays, and mechanistic investigations were conducted to determine its impact on ER stress, autophagy activation, and viral clearance.
analysis.main_results: PG treatment suppressed dengue virus infection in mosquito cells in a dose- and time-dependent manner and significantly reduced DENV2 RNA levels in adult Ae. analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of the mosquito gut microbiota in dengue virus transmission, focusing on the antiviral metabolite prodigiosin (PG) produced by Serratia marcescens strain WZ1. The research demonstrates that PG inhibits dengue virus infection by inducing ER stress and activating autophagy in mosquito cells. Mechanistic studies show that PG promotes autophagosome-lysosome convergence, leading to viral clearance. These findings reveal a novel pathway by which gut bacteria can restrict dengue virus infection, offering potential for future transmission-blocking strategies. The study's results are supported by dose-dependent experiments and molecular analyses, but its scope is limited to mosquito models, which may not fully capture the complexity of natural transmission.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨蚊虫肠道微生物群在调节虫媒病毒传播中的作用,重点在于鉴定特定的抗病毒药物代谢产物及其对抗登革病毒的机制。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究从中国温州地区捕获的Aedes albopictus中分离出Serratia marcescens WZ1菌株,并展示了其抑制登革病毒感染的能力。研究使用了蚊虫细胞和成年Ae. albopictus进行。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员通过整合代谢组学分析鉴定了Serratia marcescens WZ1菌株分泌的抗病毒药物代谢产物产色菌素(PG)。他们通过剂量和时间依赖性实验评估了PG对登革病毒感染的影响,并进行了机制研究以确定其对ER应激、自噬激活和病毒清除的作用。
elements_zh.main_results: PG在剂量和时间依赖性实验中显著抑制了蚊虫细胞中的登革病毒感染,并显著降低了成年Ae. albopictus中的DENV2 RNA水平。机制研究显示,PG诱导ER应激并上调GRP78,从而引发自噬通量。PG还促进了自噬体与溶酶体的融合,导致病毒被清除。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现揭示了一种原生蚊虫肠道共生菌代谢产物通过激活宿主 ER应激-自噬通路抑制虫媒病毒感染的新机制,为未来传播阻断策略提供了机制基础。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为利用肠道微生物群衍生代谢产物开发新的阻断虫媒病毒登革病毒和传播的策略提供了见解,可能有助于未来关于监测、诊断以及干预措施的研究。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的证据较强,因为它包括机制研究和剂量依赖性结果,但其研究局限于蚊虫细胞和成年Ae. albopictus的体外和体内实验,可能无法完全反映自然传播动态。

abstract_zh: 蚊虫肠道微生物群在调节虫媒病毒传播中起着关键作用,但其原生共生菌产生的特定抗病毒药物代谢产物及其潜在机制仍不清楚。本研究从中国温州地区捕获的Aedes albopictus中分离出一种天然肠道共生菌Serratia marcescens WZ1菌株,并证明其对登革病毒(登革病毒DENV)感染具有显著的抑制作用。通过整合代谢组学分析,我们鉴定了该菌株分泌的一种红色色素产色菌素(PG)作为功能性抗病毒药物代谢产物。PG在剂量和时间依赖性实验中显著抑制了蚊虫细胞中的DENV感染,并显著降低了成年Ae. albopictus中的DENV2 RNA水平。机制研究显示,PG优先定位于内质网(ER),诱导ER应激并上调伴侣蛋白GRP78的表达。这一过程随后激活了完整的自噬通量,表现为Atg8-I向Atg8-II的转化增强、自噬体形成增加以及溶酶体活性升高。重要的是,我们进一步证明PG促进了自噬体与溶酶体的融合,导致登革病毒与溶酶体区室共定位并最终被清除。通过基因敲低自噬基因Atg8和药理学抑制ER应激,显著减弱了PG介导的病毒抑制作用,证实了PG诱导的ER应激、自噬激活与病毒清除之间的功能联系。我们的研究阐明了一种原生蚊虫肠道共生菌代谢产物通过激活宿主 ER应激-自噬通路抑制虫媒病毒感染的新机制,为未来传播阻断策略提供了机制基础和候选靶点。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨蚊虫肠道微生物群在调节虫媒病毒传播中的作用,重点在于鉴定特定的抗病毒药物代谢产物及其对抗登革病毒的机制。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究从中国温州地区捕获的Aedes albopictus中分离出Serratia marcescens WZ1菌株,并展示了其抑制登革病毒感染的能力。研究使用了蚊虫细胞和成年Ae. albopictus进行。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员通过整合代谢组学分析鉴定了Serratia marcescens WZ1菌株分泌的抗病毒药物代谢产物产色菌素(PG)。他们通过剂量和时间依赖性实验评估了PG对登革病毒感染的影响,并进行了机制研究以确定其对ER应激、自噬激活和病毒清除的作用。
analysis_zh.main_results: PG在剂量和时间依赖性实验中显著抑制了蚊虫细胞中的登革病毒感染,并显著降低了成年Ae. albopictus中的DENV2 RNA水平。机制研究显示,PG诱导ER应激并上调GRP78,从而引发自噬通量。PG还促进了自噬体与溶酶体的融合,导致病毒被清除。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现揭示了一种原生蚊虫肠道共生菌代谢产物通过激活宿主 ER应激-自噬通路抑制虫媒病毒感染的新机制,为未来传播阻断策略提供了机制基础。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为利用肠道微生物群衍生代谢产物开发新的阻断虫媒病毒登革病毒和传播的策略提供了见解,可能有助于未来关于监测、诊断以及干预措施的研究。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的证据较强,因为它包括机制研究和剂量依赖性结果,但其研究局限于蚊虫细胞和成年Ae. albopictus的体外和体内实验,可能无法完全反映自然传播动态。

title: Repurposing of DrugBank small molecules against Dengue virus capsid protein: an in silico study.
abstract: UNLABELLED: Dengue virus (DENV) remains a pressing global health threat with no approved antiviral therapy to date. In this study, we explore the conserved hydrophobic pocket at the dimer interface of the dengue capsid protein as a novel target for antiviral intervention. Using a high-resolution capsid structure with modeled N-terminal disordered regions, we performed virtual screening of the entire DrugBank database employing AutoDock Vina to identify potential repurposable inhibitors. Six top-binding candidates were shortlisted based on docking scores and binding site specificity. These molecules were subjected to classical molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to evaluate complex stability, followed by thermal titration MD (TTMD) to assess interaction robustness under thermal stress. Three molecules-DB02152, DB08683, and DB13014-exhibited highly stable binding throughout both MD and TTMD analyses, with DB13014 (Hypericin) showing the highest thermal stability and favorable interaction energy. In silico ADMET profiling further validated the drug-like properties of these compounds, indicating acceptable oral bioavailability, low toxicity risk, and synthetic tractability. These findings highlight the dengue capsid hydrophobic pocket as a viable drug target and propose repurposing of small molecules as anti-dengue therapeutics. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s40203-026-00738-w.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒(登革病毒)仍然是一个紧迫的全球健康威胁,目前尚无批准的抗病毒药物治疗方法。本研究旨在识别针对登革病毒衣壳蛋白的潜在可再利用抑制剂。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项计算机模拟调查,探讨登革病毒衣壳蛋白二聚体界面处的保守疏水口袋。该研究使用包含建模的N端无序区域的高分辨率衣壳结构对DrugBank数据库进行虚拟筛选。
elements_zh.methods: 使用包含建模的N端无序区域的高分辨率衣壳结构,我们通过AutoDock Vina对DrugBank数据库进行了虚拟筛选,以识别潜在的可再利用抑制剂。根据对接评分和结合位点特异性,筛选出六个最佳结合候选分子。这些分子随后接受了经典分子动力学(MD)模拟以评估复合物的稳定性,并通过热滴定分子动力学(TTMD)评估其在热应激下的相互作用稳定性。
elements_zh.main_results: 三种分子(DB02152、DB08683和DB13014)在MD和TTMD分析中表现出高度稳定的结合,其中DB13014(Hypericin)显示出最高的热稳定性和有利的相互作用能量。计算机模拟的ADMET分析进一步验证了这些化合物的药物特性,表明其口服生物利用度可接受、毒性风险低且易于合成。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现突显了登革病毒衣壳蛋白疏水口袋作为可行的药物靶点,并提出了小分子药物再利用作为抗登革热治疗的可能性。本研究引入了一种新颖的方法,通过关注衣壳蛋白的结构特征来识别潜在的抑制剂。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为这些化合物作为抗登革热治疗的进一步实验验证提供了基础,为药物开发提供了潜在的先导化合物。这可能为未来关于现有药物再利用用于登革热治疗的研究提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于计算机模拟方法,可能无法完全反映体内条件。由于研究结果基于计算模型,证据强度中等,需要实验验证。

title: Insights into Dengue Prevalence, Outbreaks, Virus Replication, Diagnosis, Treatment, Vector Control, and Preventive Strategies: A Comprehensive Review
abstract: Dengue virus (DENV), a mosquito-borne RNA virus of the Flaviviridae family, poses a major global health challenge, with nearly half of the world’s population at risk and annual cases ranging from 100 to 400 million. It is transmitted primarily by Aedes mosquitoes, specifically Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, which thrive in tropical and subtropical regions. The virus consists of four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4), each conferring lifelong immunity against reinfection by the same serotype but lacking cross-immunity. The increasing incidence of dengue outbreaks is driven by climate change, urbanization, and inadequate vector control measures, with regions such as South Asia, the Americas, and Southeast Asia reporting millions of cases annually. This review provides a comprehensive analysis of dengue epidemiology, virus transmission dynamics, replication mechanisms, clinical manifestations, and diagnostic approaches. It also explores recent advancements in vaccine development, particularly the comparison between Qdenga and Dengvaxia, highlighting their differences in efficacy, safety, and target populations. Despite efforts in vaccine research, vector control remains the primary strategy for dengue prevention, focusing on environmental management, biological control, and targeted chemical interventions. The study further examines Bangladesh as a case study, documenting its largest-ever dengue outbreak in 2023 and its transition into an endemic phase in early 2025. The findings underscore the urgent need for enhanced surveillance systems, integrated vector management, and public health initiatives to combat dengue globally. Strengthening diagnostic capabilities, expanding vaccination programs, and investing in innovative mosquito control strategies will be crucial in mitigating the growing burden of dengue worldwide. Bangladesh Journal of Infectious Diseases, June 2026;13(1):397-410

source_body_en: Dengue virus (DENV), a mosquito-borne RNA virus of the Flaviviridae family, poses a major global health challenge, with nearly half of the world’s population at risk and annual cases ranging from 100 to 400 million. It is transmitted primarily by Aedes mosquitoes, specifically Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, which thrive in tropical and subtropical regions. The virus consists of four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4), each conferring lifelong immunity against reinfection by the same serotype but lacking cross-immunity. The increasing incidence of dengue outbreaks is driven by climate change, urbanization, and inadequate vector control measures, with regions such as South Asia, the Americas, and Southeast Asia reporting millions of cases annually. This review provides a comprehensive analysis of dengue epidemiology, virus transmission dynamics, replication mechanisms, clinical manifestations, and diagnostic approaches. It also explores recent advancements in vaccine development, particularly the comparison between Qdenga and Dengvaxia, highlighting their differences in efficacy, safety, and target populations. Despite efforts in vaccine research, vector control remains the primary strategy for dengue prevention, focusing on environmental management, biological control, and targeted chemical interventions. The study further examines Bangladesh as a case study, documenting its largest-ever dengue outbreak in 2023 and its transition into an endemic phase in early 2025. The findings underscore the urgent need for enhanced surveillance systems, integrated vector management, and public health initiatives to combat dengue globally. Strengthening diagnostic capabilities, expanding vaccination programs, and investing in innovative mosquito control strategies will be crucial in mitigating the growing burden of dengue worldwide. title: Acute Dengue-associated Myocarditis in a Resource-limited Setting: A Case Series From Côte D'ivoire
abstract: Abstract Dengue fever can progress to severe organ dysfunction, known as the expanded dengue syndrome. Among its atypical complications, acute myocarditis is rare, underdiagnosed, and potentially fatal. We report a series of four young male patients admitted to Treichville University Hospital (Abidjan, Côte d’Ivoire) illustrating the diverse spectrum of dengue-related myocarditis. Presentations ranged from acute heart failure to high-grade atrioventricular block requiring temporary transvenous pacing, occurring during different phases of dengue illness While elevated high-sensitivity troponin was a consistent warning sign, 3-Tesla cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging definitively confirmed myocardial inflammation via localized edema and subepicardial late gadolinium enhancement. This series highlights the need for a high index of suspicion during dengue outbreaks, where management demands a careful balance between fluid resuscitation and myocardial strain.

We report a series of four young male patients admitted to Treichville University Hospital (Abidjan, Côte d’Ivoire) illustrating the diverse spectrum of dengue-related myocarditis. Presentations ranged from acute heart failure to high-grade atrioventricular block requiring temporary transvenous pacing, occurring during different phases of dengue illness While elevated high-sensitivity troponin was a consistent warning sign, 3-Tesla cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging definitively confirmed myocardial inflammation via localized edema and subepicardial late gadolinium enhancement. This series highlights the need for a high index of suspicion during dengue outbreaks, where management demands a careful balance between fluid resuscitation and myocardial strain.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to address the underdiagnosed and potentially fatal complication of acute myocarditis associated with dengue fever, which can progress to severe organ dysfunction known as the expanded dengue syndrome. The research highlights the importance of recognizing this rare condition during dengue outbreaks.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a case series reporting on four young male patients admitted to Treichville University Hospital in Abidjan, Côte d’Ivoire, who presented with acute myocarditis during different phases of dengue illness. The population consists of individuals with dengue infection who developed myocarditis as a complication.
analysis.methods: The study involved clinical assessments of patients, including the use of high-sensitivity troponin testing and 3-Tesla cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging to confirm myocardial inflammation through localized edema and subepicardial late gadolinium enhancement. These methods were employed to evaluate the presentations and confirm the diagnosis of dengue-related myocarditis.
analysis.main_results: The patients presented with a range of symptoms, from acute heart failure to high-grade atrioventricular block requiring temporary transvenous pacing. Elevated high-sensitivity troponin was consistently observed, and 3-Tesla CMR imaging definitively confirmed myocardial inflammation in all cases.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that these cases emphasize the need for heightened clinical suspicion of myocarditis during dengue outbreaks, as it requires careful management between fluid resuscitation and myocardial strain. This case series provides novel insights into the diverse clinical manifestations of dengue-associated myocarditis.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform improved surveillance and diagnostic practices for dengue-associated myocarditis, particularly in resource-limited settings, and highlight the importance of timely and appropriate management strategies to prevent severe outcomes.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its small sample size and lack of control groups, which may affect the generalizability of the findings. However, the case series provides valuable insights into the clinical spectrum of dengue-related myocarditis, supporting a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This case series from Côte d’Ivoire reports four instances of acute myocarditis associated with dengue fever, highlighting its underdiagnosed nature and potential severity. The patients presented with varying symptoms, including acute heart failure and high-grade atrioventricular block, and were diagnosed using high-sensitivity troponin testing and 3-Tesla cardiac magnetic resonance imaging. The study underscores the importance of maintaining a high index of suspicion for myocarditis during dengue outbreaks, as management requires balancing fluid resuscitation with myocardial strain. While the small sample size and absence of control groups limit the generalizability of the findings, the cases provide novel insights into the clinical manifestations of dengue-associated myocarditis. These results can inform improved surveillance and diagnostic practices in resource-limited settings, emphasizing the need for timely and appropriate management strategies.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决与登革热相关且可能致命的急性心肌炎这一未被充分诊断的并发症。研究强调了在登革热 暴发 期间识别这一罕见状况的重要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项病例系列研究,报告了四例年轻男性患者在阿比让的特里奇维尔大学医院入院,他们在登革热病程的不同阶段表现出急性心肌炎。该人群包括因心肌炎作为并发症而患病的登革热感染者。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究包括对患者的临床评估,使用高敏肌钙蛋白检测和3特斯拉心脏磁共振成像(CMR)来通过局部水肿和心外膜下晚期钆增强确认心肌炎症。这些方法用于评估临床表现并确认登革热相关心肌炎的 诊断。
elements_zh.main_results: 患者表现出一系列症状,从急性心力衰竭到需要临时经静脉起搏的高危房室传导阻滞。高敏肌钙蛋白水平在所有病例中均一致升高,3特斯拉CMR成像在所有病例中均明确确认了心肌炎症。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,这些病例强调了在登革热 暴发 期间对心肌炎保持高度临床怀疑的必要性,因为其管理需要在补液和心肌负担之间进行谨慎平衡。该病例系列提供了关于登革热相关心肌炎多样化临床表现的新见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为登革热相关心肌炎的诊断和治疗实践提供改进的依据,特别是在资源匮乏的环境中,并强调及时和适当的管理策略对于预防严重后果的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于样本量小和缺乏对照组,这可能影响研究结果的普遍适用性。然而,该病例系列提供了关于登革热相关心肌炎临床表现范围的重要见解,支持中等程度的置信度评估。

title: Bioluminescence-based high-throughput screening and identification of direct-acting dengue virus NS5 methyltransferase inhibitors.
abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) is a mosquito-borne orthoflavivirus that infects millions of people annually across tropical and subtropical regions, posing a severe and growing threat to global public health. Currently there are no antiviral drugs available for DENV infection. The methyltransferase domain of non-structural protein 5 (NS5 MTase) catalyzes two essential methylation reaction in synthesis of the 5' cap-1 structure of viral mRNA, making it a promising yet under-validated target for anti-DENV drug development. Herein, we optimized a bioluminescence-based enzymatic MTase-Glo assay using purified recombinant DENV NS5 MTase and performed high-throughput screening of the focused Methylation Compound Library. Four compounds-SGC0946, AMI-1, salirasib, and gambogenic acid-were identified as potent DENV methylation inhibitors effective against all four serotypes (DENV-1 to -4). Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) analysis confirmed the direct binding between inhibitors and NS5 MTase. Among them, SGC0946 exhibited the strongest inhibitory activity with a half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC 50 ) of 0.05-0.11 μM against DENV-1 to -4. Molecular docking predicted that SGC0946 binds to the S-adenosylmethionine (SAM)-binding pocket of NS5 MTase. In addition, SGC0946 suppressed DENV replication in C6/36 and BHK-21 cells with EC50 values of 6.67 and 0.60 μM, respectively. Collectively, these findings identify novel DENV MTase inhibitors with diverse scaffolds and provide valuable molecular insights for the rational design of more potent NS5 MTase-targeting inhibitors in the future.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue virus (DENV) is a mosquito-borne orthoflavivirus that infects millions of people annually across tropical and subtropical regions, posing a severe and growing threat to global public health. The study aimed to identify direct-acting inhibitors of DENV NS5 methyltransferase as a potential target for antiviral drug development.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted using a bioluminescence-based enzymatic MTase-Glo assay with purified recombinant DENV NS5 MTase and a high-throughput screening approach of the focused Methylation Compound Library. The research focused on DENV-1 to DENV-4, with no mention of other flaviviruses or host populations.
analysis.methods: The methyltransferase domain of non-structural protein 5 (NS5 MTase) was used to catalyze methylation reactions in the synthesis of the 5' cap-1 structure of viral mRNA. The study optimized a bioluminescence-based enzymatic MTase-Glo assay using purified recombinant DENV NS5 MTase and performed high-throughput screening of the focused Methylation Compound Library.
analysis.main_results: Four compounds-SGC0946, AMI-1, salirasib, and gambogenic acid-were identified as potent DENV methylation inhibitors effective against all four serotypes (DENV-1 to -4). analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study identified novel DENV MTase inhibitors with diverse scaffolds and provided valuable molecular insights for the rational design of more potent NS5 MTase-targeting inhibitors in the future.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings offer potential molecular targets for the development of antiviral drugs against DENV infection, which could significantly impact public health by providing new therapeutic options for dengue disease.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study does not report limitations, but the evidence is based on in vitro assays and molecular docking predictions, which may not fully reflect in vivo efficacy or clinical relevance. The confidence in these findings is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to identify direct-acting inhibitors of the dengue virus NS5 methyltransferase, a promising target for antiviral drug development. Using a bioluminescence-based enzymatic MTase-Glo assay and high-throughput screening, four compounds were found to inhibit DENV methylation across all four serotypes. SGC0946 showed the strongest inhibitory activity with an IC50 of 0.05-0.11 μM. Molecular docking suggested SGC0946 binds to the SAM-binding pocket of NS5 MTase. These findings provide molecular insights for the design of more potent anti-DENV drugs. However, the study relies on in vitro data, which may not fully translate to clinical applications, limiting the confidence in the results to a moderate level.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究采用基于生物发光的酶促 MTase-Glo 测定法和纯化的重组 DENV NS5 MTase 以及聚焦甲基化化合物库的高通量筛选方法进行。该研究重点关注 DENV-1 至 DENV-4,没有提及其他黄病毒或 宿主 群体。
elements_zh.methods: 非结构蛋白 5 (NS5 MTase) 的甲基转移酶结构域用于催化病毒 mRNA 5' cap-1 结构合成中的甲基化反应。该研究使用纯化的重组 DENV NS5 MTase 优化了基于生物发光的酶促 MTase-Glo 测定,并对重点甲基化化合物库进行了高通量筛选。
elements_zh.main_results: 四种化合物——SGC0946、AMI-1、salirasib 和 gambogenic Acid——被确定为有效对抗所有四种血清型(DENV-1 至 -4)的有效 DENV 甲基化抑制剂。其中,SGC0946对DENV-1至-4表现出最强的抑制活性,半数抑制浓度(IC 50 )为0.05-0.11μM。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究确定了具有不同支架的新型 DENV MTase 抑制剂,并为未来合理设计更有效的 NS5 MTase 靶向抑制剂提供了宝贵的分子见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为开发抗登革热病毒感染的 抗病毒药物 药物提供了潜在的分子靶标,这可能通过为登革热疾病提供新的治疗选择来显着影响公共健康。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究没有报告局限性,但证据是基于体外测定和分子对接预测,这可能无法完全反映体内疗效或临床相关性。这些发现的可信度是中等的。

title_zh: 基于生物发光的直接作用 登革病毒 NS5 甲基转移酶抑制剂的高通量筛选和鉴定。
source_body_en: Dengue virus (DENV) is a mosquito-borne orthoflavivirus that infects millions of people annually across tropical and subtropical regions, posing a severe and growing threat to global public health. Currently there are no antiviral drugs available for DENV infection. The methyltransferase domain of non-structural protein 5 (NS5 MTase) catalyzes two essential methylation reaction in synthesis of the 5' cap-1 structure of viral mRNA, making it a promising yet under-validated target for anti-DENV drug development. Herein, we optimized a bioluminescence-based enzymatic MTase-Glo assay using purified recombinant DENV NS5 MTase and performed high-throughput screening of the focused Methylation Compound Library. Four compounds-SGC0946, AMI-1, salirasib, and gambogenic acid-were identified as potent DENV methylation inhibitors effective against all four serotypes (DENV-1 to -4). Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) analysis confirmed the direct binding between inhibitors and NS5 MTase. Among them, SGC0946 exhibited the strongest inhibitory activity with a half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC 50 ) of 0.05-0.11 μM against DENV-1 to -4. Molecular docking predicted that SGC0946 binds to the S-adenosylmethionine (SAM)-binding pocket of NS5 MTase. In addition, SGC0946 suppressed DENV replication in C6/36 and BHK-21 cells with EC50 values of 6.67 and 0.60 μM, respectively. Collectively, these findings identify novel DENV MTase inhibitors with diverse scaffolds and provide valuable molecular insights for the rational design of more potent NS5 MTase-targeting inhibitors in the future.

title: Experimental and In Silico Analysis of the Structural Dynamics of Dengue NS2B-NS3 Protease
abstract: Abstract The Dengue virus (DENV), a major global health concern, causes dengue fever, predominantly affecting tropical and subtropical regions. The NS2B-NS3 protease complex of DENV is critical for viral replication, making it a promising target for antiviral drug development. This study investigates the structural dynamics of the NS2B-NS3 protease under varying pH conditions, integrating experimental and computational approaches. The recombinant NS2B-NS3 protease was expressed in E. coli, purified using affinity chromatography, and analysed for purity via SDS-PAGE. Circular dichroism (CD) spectroscopy revealed pH-dependent secondary structural changes, indicating stability at neutral to slightly basic pH and destabilization under acidic and highly basic conditions. Dynamic light scattering (DLS) analysis demonstrated protein aggregation and structural heterogeneity under extreme pH levels. Complementary in silico techniques, including homology modelling and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, provided detailed insights into the conformational changes of the protease. The modelled structure, validated and refined through computational tools, revealed structural stability at physiological pH, with notable disruptions at pH extremes. DSSP (Dictionary of Secondary Structure of Proteins) and principal component analyses highlighted significant secondary structural transitions, especially at acidic pH where α-helices and β-sheets transformed into random coils Docking and MD simulation was carried out with the small molecule for therapeutic analysis between Dengue NS2bNS3 and small molecule. This study emphasizes the pH-dependent conformational plasticity of the NS2B-NS3 protease, contributing to the understanding of its functional mechanisms and providing a foundation for the rational design of pH-specific inhibitors. These findings underscore the importance of structural biology in advancing therapeutic strategies against dengue fever.

title: Proactive Initiative to Establish a Dengue-Free Factory Assessment Framework in Dengue High-Risk Industrial Areas: A Narrative Review.
abstract: Dengue poses a growing threat in endemic countries where industrial expansion intersects with Aedes vector-breeding habitats. Factories and manufacturing premises often generate a multitude of unmanaged water-holding containers-including water storage tanks, machinery components, landscaping features, and recyclable waste-that favor perennial reservoirs for Aedes aegypti vectors. Despite substantial public health burdens, occupational dengue prevention in the workplace remains largely reactive, fragmented, and insufficiently aligned with safety, health, and environment (SHE) management systems. This narrative review synthesizes evidence on dengue epidemiology in industrial contexts, larval source ecology in factory environments, workers' dengue risk perception, and the regulatory landscape governing occupational health in dengue-endemic countries. Drawing on these evidence domains, we propose the conceptual foundations of a proactive "Dengue-Free Factory Assessment Framework" (D-FAF) designed to prevent and reduce Ae. aegypti breeding and high dengue risk in workplaces in industrial areas, safeguard employee health, minimize work loss, and achieve a sustained reduction in dengue incidence. The framework integrates the "Plan-Do-Check-Act" (PDCA) logic of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 into a scalable, standards-aligned tool applicable across diverse industrial sectors in dengue high-risk areas.

analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that occupational dengue prevention remains reactive and fragmented, with insufficient alignment with SHE management systems. There is a lack of comprehensive frameworks for proactive dengue control in industrial settings.

title_zh: 在登革热高风险工业区建立无登革热工厂评估框架的主动举措:叙述性审查。
source_body_en: Dengue poses a growing threat in endemic countries where industrial expansion intersects with Aedes vector-breeding habitats. Factories and manufacturing premises often generate a multitude of unmanaged water-holding containers-including water storage tanks, machinery components, landscaping features, and recyclable waste-that favor perennial reservoirs for Aedes aegypti vectors. Despite substantial public health burdens, occupational dengue prevention in the workplace remains largely reactive, fragmented, and insufficiently aligned with safety, health, and environment (SHE) management systems. This narrative review synthesizes evidence on dengue epidemiology in industrial contexts, larval source ecology in factory environments, workers' dengue risk perception, and the regulatory landscape governing occupational health in dengue-endemic countries. Drawing on these evidence domains, we propose the conceptual foundations of a proactive "Dengue-Free Factory Assessment Framework" (D-FAF) designed to prevent and reduce Ae. aegypti breeding and high dengue risk in workplaces in industrial areas, safeguard employee health, minimize work loss, and achieve a sustained reduction in dengue incidence. The framework integrates the "Plan-Do-Check-Act" (PDCA) logic of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 into a scalable, standards-aligned tool applicable across diverse industrial sectors in dengue high-risk areas.
abstract_zh: 在工业扩张与伊蚊 媒介 繁殖栖息地交叉的流行国家,登革热造成的威胁日益严重。工厂和制造场所经常产生大量不受管理的储水容器,包括储水箱、机械部件、景观美化设施和可回收废物,这些容器有利于埃及伊蚊 媒介 的常年生长。尽管公共卫生负担巨大,但工作场所的职业登革热预防仍然很大程度上是被动的、分散的,并且与安全、健康和环境 (SHE) 管理体系不够一致。这篇叙述性综述综合了工业环境中登革热 流行病学、工厂环境中的幼虫源生态、工人的登革热风险认知以及登革热流行国家职业健康监管环境的证据。利用这些证据领域,我们提出了旨在预防和减少AE的主动“无登革热工厂评估框架”(D-FAF)的概念基础。控制工业区工作场所埃及伊蚊孳生和登革热高风险,保障员工健康,最大限度减少工作损失,实现登革热持续减少发病率。该框架将 ISO 45001 和 ISO 14001 的“计划-实施-检查-行动”(PDCA) 逻辑集成为可扩展、符合标准的工具,适用于登革热高风险地区的不同工业部门。

title: Modelling the impact of the El Nino Southern Oscillation (ENSO) on the dynamics of Dengue outbreaks in Argentina between 2018 and 2024.
abstract: BackgroundDengue fever has become an epidemiological concern worldwide, with 531,617 cases reported in Argentina during the 2023-2024 season. The El Nino- Southern Oscillation (ENSO) phenomenon has been linked to changes in dengue dynamics. This study assessed the relationships among ENSO, local climatic variables, and dengue outbreaks in Argentina from 2018 to 2024. MethodsA nationwide spatiotemporal analysis was conducted using dengue cases and monthly mean temperature, relative humidity, and rainfall. The Southern Oscillation Index (SOI) was used as the ENSO indicator (El Nino phase= 0.5). We fitted Hierarchical Bayesian models with Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation (INLA). A Negative Binomial distribution of dengue cases was used to account for overdispersion. Spatial dependence was modeled by using the Besag-York-Mollie 2 (BYM2) structure, adjusted for population. ResultsThe final model explained 53.7% of the variation in Argentinas departmental monthly dengue cases during the study period. Exposure-response curves of posterior probability and 95% credible intervals suggested that dengue risk increased when monthly mean temperatures were between 20{degrees} and 30{degrees} Celsius during the El Nino or neutral phase, with less consistent effects during the La Nina phase. Humidity >50% was associated with increased dengue risk during the La Nina phase, with less steep or absent associations during El Nino or neutral phases. Negative SOI scores were associated with an increased risk of dengue after controlling for the covariates. ConclusionDengue outbreaks in Argentina were independently associated with temperatures between 20 and 30 {degrees}C during the El Nino and neutral phases, humidity > 50% during the La Nina phase, and the El Nino phase of the ENSO. Incorporating ENSO indices into predictive models could enhance early warning systems and timely public health interventions in Argentina. HIGHLIGHTSO_LIThis study linked the El Nino phenomenon to Dengue fever outbreaks in Argentina. C_LIO_LIOther predictors of increased risk were monthly mean temperatures between 20{degrees} and 30{degrees} Celsius during the El Nino and neutral phases, and humidity > 50% during the La Nina phase. C_LIO_LIThere was a high degree of spatial residual variance, not accounted for by the factors considered in the model, in dengue risk, which was increased in some northern and southern provinces of Argentina.

title_zh: 模拟 2018 年至 2024 年间厄尔尼诺南方涛动 (ENSO) 对阿根廷登革热 暴发 动态的影响。
source_body_en: BackgroundDengue fever has become an epidemiological concern worldwide, with 531,617 cases reported in Argentina during the 2023-2024 season. The El Nino- Southern Oscillation (ENSO) phenomenon has been linked to changes in dengue dynamics. This study assessed the relationships among ENSO, local climatic variables, and dengue outbreaks in Argentina from 2018 to 2024. MethodsA nationwide spatiotemporal analysis was conducted using dengue cases and monthly mean temperature, relative humidity, and rainfall. The Southern Oscillation Index (SOI) was used as the ENSO indicator (El Nino phase= 0.5). We fitted Hierarchical Bayesian models with Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation (INLA). A Negative Binomial distribution of dengue cases was used to account for overdispersion. Spatial dependence was modeled by using the Besag-York-Mollie 2 (BYM2) structure, adjusted for population. ResultsThe final model explained 53.7% of the variation in Argentinas departmental monthly dengue cases during the study period. Exposure-response curves of posterior probability and 95% credible intervals suggested that dengue risk increased when monthly mean temperatures were between 20{degrees} and 30{degrees} Celsius during the El Nino or neutral phase, with less consistent effects during the La Nina phase. Humidity >50% was associated with increased dengue risk during the La Nina phase, with less steep or absent associations during El Nino or neutral phases. Negative SOI scores were associated with an increased risk of dengue after controlling for the covariates. ConclusionDengue outbreaks in Argentina were independently associated with temperatures between 20 and 30 {degrees}C during the El Nino and neutral phases, humidity > 50% during the La Nina phase, and the El Nino phase of the ENSO. Incorporating ENSO indices into predictive models could enhance early warning systems and timely public health interventions in Argentina. HIGHLIGHTSO_LIThis study linked the El Nino phenomenon to Dengue fever outbreaks in Argentina. C_LIO_LIOther predictors of increased risk were monthly mean temperatures between 20{degrees} and 30{degrees} Celsius during the El Nino and neutral phases, and humidity > 50% during the La Nina phase. C_LIO_LIThere was a high degree of spatial residual variance, not accounted for by the factors considered in the model, in dengue risk, which was increased in some northern and southern provinces of Argentina.
abstract_zh: 背景登革热已成为全球流行病学关注的问题,2023-2024 年季节阿根廷报告了 531,617 例病例。厄尔尼诺南方涛动 (ENSO) 现象与登革热动态变化有关。本研究评估了2018年至2024年阿根廷ENSO、当地气候变量和登革热暴发之间的关系。方法利用登革热病例和月平均气温、相对湿度和降雨量进行全国时空分析。南方涛动指数(SOI)被用作ENSO指标(厄尔尼诺相位= 0.5)。我们使用集成嵌套拉普拉斯逼近(INLA)来拟合分层贝叶斯模型。使用登革热病例的负二项分布来解释过度分散的情况。使用 Besag-York-Mollie 2 (BYM2) 结构对空间依赖性进行建模,并根据人口进行调整。结果最终模型解释了研究期间阿根廷部门每月登革热病例的 53.7% 的变异。后验概率和 95% 可信区间的暴露-反应曲线表明,在厄尔尼诺或中性阶段,当月平均气温在 20°C 至 30°C 之间时,登革热风险增加,而在拉尼娜阶段,影响不太一致。湿度 >50% 与拉尼娜阶段的登革热风险增加相关,而在厄尔尼诺阶段或中性阶段,相关性不太陡峭或不存在。控制协变量后,负 SOI 评分与登革热风险增加相关。结论 阿根廷登革热 暴发 与厄尔尼诺和中性阶段温度在 20 至 30°C 之间、拉尼娜阶段湿度 > 50% 以及 ENSO 厄尔尼诺阶段湿度独立相关。将 ENSO 指数纳入预测模型可以增强阿根廷的早期预警系统和及时的公共卫生干预措施。亮点SO_LI这项研究将厄尔尼诺现象与阿根廷的 登革热 暴发 联系起来。C_LIO_LIO风险增加的其他预测因素是厄尔尼诺和中性阶段的月平均气温在 20 摄氏度到 30 摄氏度之间,拉尼娜阶段的湿度> 50%。C_LIO_LI 登革热风险存在高度的空间残差方差,但模型中考虑的因素并未对此进行解释,而登革热风险在阿根廷北部和南部的一些省份有所增加。

title: Severe Dengue in Children: Pathogenesis, Early Recognition, and Evidence-Informed Management
abstract: Severe dengue remains an important cause of pediatric hospitalization, morbidity, and mortality in tropical and subtropical regions, particularly where rapid triage and pediatric critical-care capacity are limited. This structured narrative review synthesizes evidence on the epidemiology, pathogenesis, early recognition, diagnosis, management, and prevention of severe dengue in children. Severe disease reflects interactions among viral factors, pre-existing immunity, dysregulated host responses, and microvascular endothelial injury. Antibody-dependent enhancement, inflammatory mediators, dengue nonstructural protein 1, and endothelial glycocalyx disruption contribute to vascular hyperpermeability, plasma leakage, shock, severe bleeding, and organ impairment. Because deterioration often occurs abruptly around defervescence, serial clinical assessment, hematocrit trends, urine-output monitoring, and timely recognition of warning signs are central to risk stratification. Molecular assays and NS1 antigen testing are most useful during the early febrile phase, although diagnostic performance varies with illness timing and immune status. Carefully titrated isotonic crystalloid therapy remains the cornerstone of treatment; both delayed resuscitation and excessive fluid administration may worsen outcomes. Reducing mortality requires integrated clinical and public-health strategies combining standardized pediatric management, accessible diagnostics, effective referral systems, vaccination where appropriate, surveillance, and vector control.

title_zh: 儿童 重症登革热:重症登革热、早期识别和循证管理
source_body_en: Severe dengue remains an important cause of pediatric hospitalization, morbidity, and mortality in tropical and subtropical regions, particularly where rapid triage and pediatric critical-care capacity are limited. This structured narrative review synthesizes evidence on the epidemiology, pathogenesis, early recognition, diagnosis, management, and prevention of severe dengue in children. Severe disease reflects interactions among viral factors, pre-existing immunity, dysregulated host responses, and microvascular endothelial injury. Antibody-dependent enhancement, inflammatory mediators, dengue nonstructural protein 1, and endothelial glycocalyx disruption contribute to vascular hyperpermeability, plasma leakage, shock, severe bleeding, and organ impairment. Because deterioration often occurs abruptly around defervescence, serial clinical assessment, hematocrit trends, urine-output monitoring, and timely recognition of warning signs are central to risk stratification. Molecular assays and NS1 antigen testing are most useful during the early febrile phase, although diagnostic performance varies with illness timing and immune status. Carefully titrated isotonic crystalloid therapy remains the cornerstone of treatment; both delayed resuscitation and excessive fluid administration may worsen outcomes. Reducing mortality requires integrated clinical and public-health strategies combining standardized pediatric management, accessible diagnostics, effective referral systems, vaccination where appropriate, surveillance, and vector control.

title: Molecular detection and spatial distribution of circulating dengue virus serotypes in an urban high-incidence area of Mataram, Indonesia (2024–2025)
abstract: Abstract Dengue fever (DF) is a mosquito-borne viral disease caused by four dengue virus serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4) and remains a major public health concern in tropical regions, including Indonesia. In 2024, Mataram City reported 364 confirmed dengue cases, indicating a substantial local burden. This observational cross-sectional study was conducted from November 2024 to January 2025 in eight high-incidence neighborhood associations within the Karang Pule Health Center working area, Mataram City. Mosquito larvae and ovitrap samples were collected from case-based households following WHO entomological surveillance guidelines, reared to F1 adult females, and pooled (20 mosquitoes per site) for viral RNA extraction. Dengue virus detection and serotyping were performed using a one-step RT-PCR assay with serotype-specific primers, including appropriate positive and negative controls to ensure assay validity. Five of eight sampling locations were positive for DENV. DENV-3 was the predominant serotype, detected in three locations, while co-circulation of DENV-2 and DENV-3 was identified in two locations. No DENV-1 or DENV-4 was detected. Villages such as West Pagutan exhibited the highest proportion of reported cases and incidence rates. Environmental parameters (temperature, humidity, water temperature, and light intensity) were recorded at each site and analyzed descriptively. The detection of DENV in F1-generation Aedes aegypti supports evidence of ongoing local viral circulation and suggests the potential contribution of vertical (transovarial) transmission in maintaining the virus reservoir. This study provides fine-scale, sub-district-level mapping of dengue serotype distribution in an urban Indonesian setting, offering localized evidence to support targeted vector control strategies while acknowledging limitations related to sample size and geographic coverage.
journal: Journal of Umm Al-Qura University for Applied Sciences

title: Dengue virus serotype classification from complete genomes using a Transformer with chunk-based sequence modeling and explainability analysis
abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly used for genomic surveillance of infectious diseases, but predictive models must be evaluated under realistic generalization settings and interpreted cautiously. We present XAI-DENFormer, an explainability-oriented framework for dengue virus (DENV) serotype classification from complete viral genomes. A curated dataset of 29,091 publicly available DENV genomes was encoded as nucleotide-level one-hot sequences and processed with a chunk-based Transformer encoder designed for memory-efficient whole-genome analysis. Generalization was assessed using three complementary validation protocols: CD-HIT cluster-aware, geographical, and temporal validation. DENFormer variants were benchmarked against Logistic Regression, a feed-forward neural network, Longformer, and Performer under identical conditions. The mean-pooling DENFormer configuration maintained high performance across all three validation protocols, with accuracies of 98.68–99.91% across CD-HIT folds, 97.18–100.00% across geographical holdouts, and 96.35–99.86% across temporal holdouts. To inspect model behavior, we combined attention maps, Gradient × Input attributions, embedding visualizations, and regional statistical analyses. The resulting profiles supported distributed serotype-associated signals across structural, non-structural, and untranslated regions rather than reliance on a single genomic locus. XAI-DENFormer provides a robust and interpretable framework for large-scale DENV genome classification and model-guided genomic inspection.

title: Genomic analysis identifies candidate supergene architecture for host-feeding behavior in wild Aedes aegypti dengue vector mosquitoes
abstract: Background Aedes aegypti is the primary arboviral vector globally, and its affinity to feed on human hosts is a key determinant of transmission intensity. Despite the epidemiological importance of anthropophily, the genomic architecture underlying the molecular basis of host-feeding behavior remains understudied. Methods Here, we present an integrated genome-wide association study (GWAS) and structural variant analysis of host-feeding behavior in 21 field-collected Ae. aegypti females phenotyped as human-blood-fed (HF; n = 11) or non-human-blood-fed (NHF; n = 10). Whole-genome sequencing yielded 661,519 high-quality SNPs distributed across all three chromosomes. Principal component analysis on a linkage disequilibrium-pruned dataset revealed modest population structure (PC1 = 11.69%, PC2 = 10.98%). Results GWAS using a general linear model with five PC covariates (λ = 1.05) identified 11 suggestive SNPs in genes including an actin binding protein on chromosome 2 and G-protein coupled receptor 39 on chromosome 3. abstract_zh: 背景 埃及伊蚊是全球主要的虫媒病毒 媒介,其以人类 宿主 为食的亲和力是 传播 强度的关键决定因素。尽管人类性在流行病学上具有重要性,但 宿主 进食行为的分子基础的基因组结构仍未得到充分研究。方法在这里,我们提出了一项综合的 基因组 全关联研究 (GWAS) 和对 21 种现场采集的白蚊 宿主 摄食行为的结构变异分析。埃及伊蚊雌性的表型为人类血液喂养(HF;n = 11)或非人类血液喂养(NHF;n = 10)。全 基因组 测序产生了分布在所有三个染色体上的 661,519 个高质量 SNP。对连锁不平衡修剪数据集的主成分分析揭示了适度的群体结构(PC1 = 11.69%,PC2 = 10.98%)。结果 GWAS 使用具有 5 个 PC 协变量 (λ = 1.05) 的一般线性模型在基因中识别出 11 个暗示性 SNP,包括 2 号染色体上的肌动蛋白结合蛋白和 3 号染色体上的 G 蛋白偶联受体 39。使用 Delly 进行的染色体倒位分析确定了 2 号染色体上的 HF 特异性倒位,其中包含 13 个基因,涵盖三个功能上一致的化学感应类别:感觉发育调节器水龙头、气味受体(Or6、 Or31、Or33)和气味结合蛋白(Gp68)以及八个味觉受体基因(Gr15–Gr19a、Gr35、Gr36、Gr66)。结论 单个非重组染色体单位内共同适应的化学感应基因的浓度与可能的人性化超基因模型一致,与冈比亚按蚊中倒位介导的行为分歧相一致。这些探索性发现为伊蚊 宿主 寻找行为提供了初步的基因组框架。aegypti 并确定可能的候选基因座,在应用于 媒介 监测 之前保证功能验证。

title: A structural bridge between dengue virus tandem xrRNAs facilitates coordination of exonuclease resistance
abstract: ABSTRACT Orthoflavivirus RNA genomes resist host 5′–3′ exoribonucleases to produce subgenomic flaviviral RNAs (sfRNAs). This resistance is conferred by exoribonuclease-resistant RNA (xrRNA) structures within the viral 3′ untranslated region that often occur in tandem, and whose function can be coupled. In dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV2), this coupling results in changing patterns of sfRNA identity and abundance associated with the ability of the virus to adapt to host vs. The physical basis of this coupling was unknown. Using a combination of virology, biochemistry, bioinformatics, structural biology, and biophysics, we explored the structural and sequence determinants of tandem xrRNA coupling in DENV2. We discovered that the spatial proximity, order, and structural integrity of the tandem xrRNAs are all important for coupling. Furthermore, an unpaired A-rich linker that lies between the two xrRNAs is essential in stabilizing a specific structure that correlates to coupling. This A-rich sequence likely forms tertiary contacts with an adjacent stem-loop structure to form a physical bridge between the two xrRNAs, a finding that is supported by a mid-resolution cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) map of the DENV2 tandem xrRNAs. Disruption of the structure of this bridge by mutation changes the relative orientation or spacing between the tandem xrRNAs, which is correlated to their functional coupling. These findings help provide an explanation for the coupling between tandem xrRNAs, suggesting a new mechanistic hypothesis in which the two tandem xrRNAs can simultaneously encounter Xrn1. IMPORTANCE Dengue virus (DENV) generates non-coding subgenomic flaviviral RNAs (sfRNAs) that affect several cellular pathways and are important for successful infection. These sfRNAs are formed by structured RNA elements in the viral genome called exoribonuclease-resistant RNAs (xrRNAs), which fold into a distinct three-dimensional topology to block degradation by host cell exoribonucleases and often occur in tandem. Specific patterns of sfRNAs made during infection are important for host vs. vector fitness, and in DENV2, this pattern depends on functional coupling between tandem xrRNAs. However, the source of this functional coupling was unknown. We determined that an unpaired A-rich linker between the tandem xrRNAs is necessary for creating a structural bridge between the tandem xrRNAs. This bridge appears to favor a specific orientation between the tandem xrRNAs that is correlated to coupling and therefore to the patterns and relative abundance of sfRNAs produced during infection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue virus generates subgenomic flaviviral RNAs (sfRNAs) that are important for successful infection, but the mechanism underlying the functional coupling between tandem xrRNAs was unknown. This study aimed to uncover the structural basis of this coupling.

The research was conducted in a laboratory setting.
analysis.methods: The researchers used a multidisciplinary approach, combining virology, biochemistry, bioinformatics, structural biology, and biophysics to investigate the structural and sequence determinants of tandem xrRNA coupling in DENV2. They analyzed the spatial proximity, order, and structural integrity of the tandem xrRNAs and examined the role of an unpaired A-rich linker.
analysis.main_results: The study found that the spatial proximity, order, and structural integrity of the tandem xrRNAs are important for their coupling. Additionally, an unpaired A-rich linker between the two xrRNAs is essential for stabilizing a specific structure that correlates with coupling.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the A-rich linker forms a physical bridge between the tandem xrRNAs, favoring a specific orientation that is correlated with their functional coupling. This provides a new mechanistic hypothesis for how tandem xrRNAs can simultaneously encounter Xrn1.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results contribute to understanding the molecular mechanisms of dengue virus RNA resistance to host exoribonucleases, which could inform future studies on viral adaptation and the development of antiviral strategies targeting RNA degradation.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on abstract-only evidence, which limits the depth of analysis. However, the findings are supported by a mid-resolution cryo-EM map and mutation experiments, providing moderate confidence in the structural model proposed.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the structural basis of functional coupling between tandem xrRNAs in dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV2). The researchers used a multidisciplinary approach to explore how spatial proximity, order, and structural integrity of these xrRNAs contribute to their coupling. They discovered that an unpaired A-rich linker between the xrRNAs is essential for stabilizing a specific structure that correlates with functional coupling. The findings suggest that this A-rich linker forms a physical bridge between the xrRNAs, favoring a specific orientation that allows them to simultaneously encounter Xrn1. These results provide new insights into the molecular mechanisms of DENV2 RNA resistance to host exoribonucleases, which could inform future research on viral adaptation and antiviral strategies. The study is based on abstract-only evidence, which limits the depth of analysis, but the findings are supported by a mid-resolution cryo-EM map and mutation experiments, offering moderate confidence in the proposed structural model.

abstract_zh: 摘要 正黄病毒 RNA 基因组 可抵抗 宿主 5'–3' 核糖核酸外切酶,产生亚基因组黄病毒 RNA (sfRNA)。这种抵抗力是由病毒 3' 非翻译区内的外核糖核酸酶抗性 RNA (xrRNA) 结构赋予的,这些结构通常串联出现,并且其功能可以耦合。在 登革病毒 血清型 2 (DENV2) 中,这种偶联导致与病毒适应 宿主 的能力相关的 sfRNA 特性和丰度模式发生变化。这种偶联的物理基础尚不清楚。我们结合病毒学、生物化学、生物信息学、结构生物学和生物物理学,探索了 DENV2 中串联 xrRNA 偶联的结构和序列决定因素。我们发现串联 xrRNA 的空间邻近性、顺序和结构完整性对于偶联都很重要。此外,位于两个 xrRNA 之间的未配对的富含 A 的接头对于稳定与偶联相关的特定结构至关重要。这种富含 A 的序列可能与相邻的茎环结构形成三级接触,从而在两个 xrRNA 之间形成物理桥,这一发现得到了 DENV2 串联 xrRNA 的中分辨率冷冻电子显微镜 (cryo-EM) 图的支持。突变 破坏该桥的结构会改变串联 xrRNA 之间的相对方向或间距,这与其功能耦合相关。这些发现有助于为串联 xrRNA 之间的耦合提供解释,提出一种新的机制假设,其中两个串联 xrRNA 可以同时遇到 Xrn1。重要性 登革病毒 (DENV) 产生非编码亚基因组黄病毒 RNA (sfRNA),影响多种细胞途径,对于成功感染非常重要。这些 sfRNA 由病毒 基因组 中称为核糖核酸外切酶抗性 RNA (xrRNA) 的结构化 RNA 元件形成,它们折叠成独特的三维拓扑结构,以阻止 宿主 细胞核糖核酸外切酶的降解,并且通常串联发生。感染期间产生的 sfRNA 的特定模式对于 宿主 与 媒介 的适应性非常重要,并且在 DENV2 中,这种模式取决于串联 xrRNA 之间的功能耦合。然而,这种功能耦合的来源尚不清楚。我们确定串联 xrRNA 之间未配对的富含 A 的接头对于在串联 xrRNA 之间创建结构桥是必要的。这种桥似乎有利于串联 xrRNA 之间的特定方向,该方向与耦合相关,因此与感染期间产生的 sfRNA 的模式和相对丰度相关。
