title: Optimizing dengue virus surveillance in wastewater through shedding dynamics and RNA stability analysis: Implications for early warning systems
abstract: Wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE) for dengue virus (DENV) is a promising tool but hindered by a lack of fundamental data on viral shedding and stability. Here, we mapped high-resolution longitudinal shedding trajectories by analyzing 769 serial saliva, urine, and fecal specimens collected from a prospective cohort of 132 hospitalized patients across a 23-day post-symptom onset window, resolved degradation constants within authentic environmental matrices, and constructed a predictive forward sensitivity model. Clinical screening identified urine as the most reliable surveillance target, exhibiting a diagnostic positivity rate of 88.4%. However, stability experiments benchmarking a 25°C subterranean sewer baseline revealed that DENV-1 RNA within authentic patient excreta mixtures (mixed urine, feces, and saliva) degraded nearly fivefold faster than standard pseudovirus spikes in simplified controls, yielding a 90% decay time T 90 ) of approximately 3.4 days. Modeling results indicate that this accelerated degradation limits conventional centralized grab sampling to a detection threshold of 1 infection per 184 individuals. In contrast, near-source passive sampling can overcome this bottleneck, achieving a theoretical detection limit of 1 case per 35,130 people. Factoring in empirical field detection limits, this time-integrated approach maintains a highly sensitive practical detection threshold ranging from 1 case per 3,513 to 17,565 individuals.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to optimize dengue virus surveillance in wastewater by analyzing shedding dynamics and RNA stability. The researchers collected serial saliva, urine, and fecal specimens from 132 hospitalized patients over 23 days post-symptom onset to map viral shedding trajectories. They also conducted stability experiments in authentic environmental matrices and developed a predictive model. The results showed that DENV-1 RNA in patient excreta mixtures degraded fivefold faster than in simplified controls, with a 90% decay time of approximately 3.4 days. However, the practical detection threshold remains dependent on field conditions and requires further validation.

title: Decompressive hemicraniectomy for fulminant acute disseminated encephalomyelitis following dengue fever: Case report and literature review
abstract: Background: Acute disseminated encephalomyelitis (ADEM) is a rare immune-mediated demyelinating disorder of the central nervous system that typically occurs after viral or bacterial infections. Although most patients respond favorably to immunomodulatory therapy, a small subset develops fulminant ADEM characterized by malignant cerebral edema, refractory intracranial hypertension, and a high risk of mortality. Decompressive craniectomy has rarely been reported as a life-saving intervention in such cases. Case Description: A 25-year-old woman developed fulminant ADEM following dengue fever and initially presented with recurrent seizures progressing to status epilepticus. Brain magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated extensive bilateral demyelinating lesions involving the frontoparietal, occipital, temporal, and cerebellar white matter, with extension into the corpus callosum. Despite aggressive medical management, including high-dose intravenous methylprednisolone, osmotherapy, sedation, and plasma exchange, the patient experienced progressive neurological deterioration associated with diffuse cerebral edema, anisocoria, and radiological evidence of impending cerebral herniation. Owing to the failure of maximal medical therapy, a left decompressive hemicraniectomy was performed. The patient subsequently underwent additional immunomodulatory treatment, survived the acute phase of the disease, and demonstrated significant neurological recovery. A review of the literature identified nine previously reported cases of fulminant ADEM treated with decompressive craniectomy. Conclusion: Fulminant ADEM is an uncommon but potentially fatal neurological emergency. In cases complicated by malignant cerebral edema and refractory intracranial hypertension, decompressive craniectomy may represent a life-saving therapeutic option. Early recognition and timely surgical intervention appear to be associated with favorable neurological outcomes.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the use of decompressive hemicraniectomy for fulminant acute disseminated encephalomyelitis (ADEM) following dengue fever. The central question is whether decompressive craniectomy is a viable life-saving intervention in cases of fulminant ADEM caused by dengue virus.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a case report combined with a literature review. It includes a single case study of a 25-year-old woman with fulminant ADEM following dengue fever and references nine previously reported cases of fulminant ADEM treated with decompressive craniectomy. The review does not explicitly report on meta-analysis or consensus processes.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that fulminant ADEM is an uncommon but potentially fatal neurological emergency. It suggests that decompressive craniectomy may represent a life-saving therapeutic option in cases complicated by malignant cerebral edema and refractory intracranial hypertension. Early recognition and timely surgical intervention are associated with favorable neurological outcomes.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evidence is limited to case reports, which are not robust enough to establish a definitive consensus. There is no mention of randomized controlled trials or large-scale studies to support the use of decompressive craniectomy in fulminant ADEM. The review also does not address the mechanisms underlying the development of fulminant ADEM or its relationship with dengue virus.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Further research is needed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of decompressive craniectomy in fulminant ADEM caused by dengue virus. This includes conducting randomized controlled trials and exploring the pathophysiological mechanisms of fulminant ADEM. In clinical practice, early recognition of fulminant ADEM and prompt surgical intervention may be critical for improving patient outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the use of decompressive hemicraniectomy as a potential life-saving intervention for fulminant acute disseminated encephalomyelitis (ADEM) following dengue fever. It presents a case report of a 25-year-old woman who developed fulminant ADEM after dengue infection and was treated with decompressive craniectomy. The review also summarizes nine previously reported cases of fulminant ADEM treated with similar interventions. The findings suggest that decompressive craniectomy may be a therapeutic option in severe cases of ADEM with malignant cerebral edema and refractory intracranial hypertension. However, the evidence is limited to case reports, and there is a need for more rigorous studies to confirm its efficacy. The review highlights the importance of early recognition and timely surgical intervention in improving outcomes for patients with fulminant ADEM.

title: Targeting Dengue Viral Proteins with Eco-Friendly Nanotechnology: A Promising Path for Antiviral Research
abstract: Dengue virus (DENV), a mosquito-borne pathogen belonging to the Flaviviridae family, continues to be a major global public health concern, causing millions of infections annually across tropical and subtropical regions. The virus encodes both structural and non-structural proteins that play critical roles in its replication, assembly, and immune evasion. Despite substantial research progress, there is still no specific antiviral drug available, and current treatment remains primarily supportive. This review highlights the significance of DENV structural proteins (C, prM/M, and E) and non-structural proteins (NS1–NS5) as potential molecular targets for antiviral interventions. Green-synthesized silver, gold, and iron oxide nanoparticles have demonstrated strong inhibitory activity against DENV by targeting key viral proteins such as the envelope (E), NS3 protease/helicase, and NS5 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase. These nanoparticles interfere with viral entry, replication, and protein synthesis while exhibiting high biocompatibility and minimal cytotoxicity. Collectively, the findings discussed in this review underscore the promise of eco-friendly nanotechnology as a sustainable and effective platform for developing next-generation antiviral therapies against dengue virus.

title: Predicting Dengue Clinical Severity in Eastern Sudan's 2023 Outbreak: A Comparative Analysis of Statistical and Machine Learning Models Using Routine Surveillance Data
abstract: Objectives: This study characterized clinical severity patterns during the 2023 dengue outbreak in Al Qadarif State, Eastern Sudan; identified associated factors; compared statistical and machine-learning models; and explored patterns of clinical manifestations using routine surveillance data. Methods: This retrospective observational study included 2,552 dengue case records. The primary outcome was a pragmatic, study-specific composite clinical severity indicator, defined as the documented presence of bleeding, severe bleeding, loss of consciousness, convulsions, or thrombocytopenia.Analyses included descriptive statistics, multivariable logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost, multiple correspondence analysis, and hierarchical clustering. Model performance was assessed using a stratified hold-out test set, with uncertainty estimated from 1,000 bootstrap resamples. Results: Overall, 182 patients (7.13%) met the study-specific composite clinical severity indicator.Thirty-two deaths were recorded, giving a case-fatality rate of 1.25%. Mortality was higher among patients with severity markers than among those without them (3.85% vs. 1.05%; relative risk=3.65). Skin rash showed the strongest adjusted association with the composite severity indicator (adjusted OR=6.26, 95% CI: 3.15–12.45; P<0.001), followed by symptom-onset timing (adjusted OR=4.65, 95% CI: 2.41–8.98; P<0.001). XGBoost achieved the numerically highest AUROC (0.765, 95% CI: 0.691–0.837) and the lowest Brier score (0.161, 95% CI: 0.145–0.176). Multiple correspondence analysis suggested hemorrhagic and neurological/systemic symptom patterns. Conclusion: The study-specific composite clinical severity indicator was uncommon but was associated with a higher risk of death. Skin rash and symptom-onset timing showed the strongest adjusted associations with the study-specific composite clinical severity indicator. Predictive performance was moderate, and the findings require confirmation using independent datasets with more detailed clinical and laboratory information.
journal: International Journal of Statistics in Medical Research

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用东部苏丹阿尔卡达里夫州2023年2,552例登革热病例记录进行回顾性观察研究,重点关注有记录临床表现的患者。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究利用常规监测数据定义了一个基于研究的综合临床严重程度指标。分析包括描述性统计、多变量逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost、多重对应分析和层次聚类。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究特定的复合临床严重程度指标并不常见,但与较高的死亡风险相关。皮疹和症状出现时间与综合严重程度指标显示出最强的调整相关性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为制定更准确的临床严重程度指标提供信息,并改善对苏丹东部登革热患者的风险评估。他们还强调了监测特定临床标志物对于早期识别重症病例的重要性。

title: Local thermal anomalies and the altitudinal rise of dengue hospitalisation rates in Ecuador, 2011–2024: a national ecological study
abstract: Introduction Dengue is expanding beyond its traditional lowland range as rising temperatures may enable Aedes aegypti establishment at progressively higher altitudes. Ecuador, spanning sea level to above 4500 m, offers a natural altitudinal experiment, yet hospital-based evidence on the thermal drivers of Andean dengue is lacking. Methods We conducted a national ecological time-series analysis at the canton level using Ecuador's hospital discharge registry (INEC) for 2011–2024, the period with standardised canton coding, identifying dengue hospitalisations by ICD-10 codes A90, A91 and A97. Monthly land surface temperature, precipitation and vegetation index were derived from MODIS and GPM products. A distributed lag non-linear model estimated the temperature–hospitalisation association; a quasi-Poisson model restricted to Andean cantons (≥1500 m), with canton, calendar-month and year fixed effects, tested whether thermal anomalies above each canton's 2007–2015 baseline were associated with hospitalisation rates. Results Among 74,601 dengue hospitalisations with a resolvable canton of residence (232 deaths; case fatality 0.31%), dengue was recorded in 68 cantons above 1500 m, including altitudes exceeding 3000 m. The national hospitalisation rate rose from 29.7 to 77.0 per 100,000 and the Andean rate approximately 7-fold (1.9 to 12.8). The minimum hospitalisation temperature was 18.4°C nationally and 18.9°C in Andean cantons. A +1°C anomaly versus zero was associated with a 1.07-fold increase in hospitalisation rates (95% CI 1.02–1.13; p = 0.012). Without canton fixed effects, the same contrast yielded 1.21 (1.07–1.36); the within-canton association fell to 1.04 (1.00–1.08) when the 2024 epidemic year was excluded. Discussion Positive deviations from local historical baselines, rather than absolute temperature, were associated with rising dengue hospitalisation rates among Andean residents, by a modest margin that depends materially on the 2023–2024 epidemic. In-hospital case fatality was nearly twice as high in low Andean cantons (0.62%, 95% CI 0.20–1.45; five deaths) as on the coast (0.33%), a non-significant difference that nonetheless supports strengthening dengue recognition in highland facilities.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the relationship between local thermal anomalies and the altitudinal rise of dengue hospitalisation rates in Ecuador from 2011 to 2024. It highlights the expansion of dengue beyond traditional lowland areas and the potential influence of temperature changes on hospitalisation rates in higher altitude regions. The research utilises a national ecological time-series analysis of hospital discharge data, identifying dengue cases through ICD-10 codes. Results show that dengue hospitalisations occurred in cantons above 1500 m, with a significant increase in rates associated with temperature anomalies. The study suggests that local thermal variations, rather than absolute temperatures, may drive dengue hospitalisations in the Andes, particularly during the 2023–2024 epidemic. These findings have implications for improving dengue surveillance and recognition in highland facilities, but the study's ecological design and potential confounding factors limit the strength of the conclusions.

title: Neonatal Dengue Infection Mimicking Late-Onset Neonatal Sepsis in Endemic Regions: A Case Report Series and a Proposed Diagnostic Framework for Antimicrobial Stewardship
abstract: Neonatal dengue infection may mimic late-onset neonatal sepsis (LOS) in endemic regions, leading to misdiagnosis and unnecessary antibiotic exposure. We describe a case series of neonates admitted to a tertiary referral hospital in a dengue-endemic area with suspected LOS who underwent standard sepsis evaluation, including blood cultures, inflammatory markers, and clinical assessment, and were subsequently tested for dengue infection by anti-dengue virus IgM using ELFA methodology on the VIDAS® platform. All patients presented with fever and hematologic abnormalities, particularly thrombocytopenia and/or leukopenia, while blood and urine cultures remained negative and procalcitonin levels were low or normal. Dengue IgM was positive in all cases, supporting the diagnosis of neonatal dengue infection. After diagnostic confirmation, antibiotics were discontinued when applicable, and all neonates had favorable clinical outcomes without complications at discharge. These findings highlight dengue as a potentially underrecognized differential diagnosis of LOS in endemic settings and suggest that arboviral testing may be considered in the diagnostic evaluation of neonates with suspected sepsis, particularly when cultures are negative and inflammatory markers are not suggestive of bacterial infection. Early recognition may help reduce unnecessary antimicrobial exposure and could support antimicrobial stewardship efforts.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a case series of neonates in a dengue-endemic region who exhibited symptoms resembling late-onset neonatal sepsis but were later diagnosed with neonatal dengue infection. The research aimed to highlight dengue as a potential differential diagnosis for neonatal sepsis, especially when standard diagnostic tests fail to identify bacterial causes. The study found that all neonates had positive dengue IgM results, indicating a clear diagnosis of dengue infection. The authors suggest that arboviral testing should be considered in neonates with suspected sepsis and negative cultures, to avoid unnecessary antibiotic use. The findings emphasize the importance of early recognition of dengue in neonates to support antimicrobial stewardship. The study is limited by its case series design, which may not capture broader trends, but the evidence is strong due to the clear diagnostic results and favorable clinical outcomes. The study contributes to the understanding of dengue in neonates and its implications for clinical practice in endemic areas.

abstract_zh: 新生儿登革热感染可能在流行地区模拟晚发性新生儿脓毒症(LOS),导致误诊和不必要的抗生素暴露。我们描述了一组在登革热流行地区被收治于三级转诊医院的新生儿病例,这些新生儿疑似患有LOS,接受了标准的脓毒症评估,包括血液培养、炎症标志物和临床评估,并随后通过VIDAS®平台上的ELFA方法检测了抗-登革病毒 IgM以确定登革热感染。所有患者均表现为发热和血液学异常,特别是血小板减少和/或白细胞减少,而血液和尿液培养结果均为阴性,降钙素原水平低或正常。所有病例的登革热IgM均为阳性,支持新生儿登革热感染的诊断。在确诊后,当适用时停用抗生素,所有新生儿在出院时均表现出良好的临床结局,无并发症。这些发现强调登革热可能是流行地区LOS的一个被低估的鉴别诊断诊断,并建议在疑似脓毒症的新生儿中考虑进行虫媒病毒检测,尤其是在培养结果为阴性且炎症标志物不提示细菌感染的情况下。早期识别有助于减少不必要的抗菌药物暴露,并可能支持抗菌药物管理的努力。

title: Environmental BPA exposure promotes flavivirus replication and extends mosquito lifespan.
abstract: Environmental exposure to endocrine-disrupting chemicals (EDCs) is widespread, yet their influence on arthropod-borne virus transmission remains poorly understood. Here, we show that bisphenol A (BPA), a common EDC, enhances the replication of Zika virus (ZIKV) and Dengue virus (DENV) in the mosquito Aedes aegypti by modulating host oxidative stress responses. Through systematic screening of nine EDCs, BPA and dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane (DDT), significantly promoted viral replication, with BPA exhibiting the strongest effect. Chronic larval exposure to BPA led to its residual accumulation in adults and increased susceptibility to viral infection. Transcriptomic and biochemical analyses revealed that BPA upregulates antioxidant enzymes-superoxide dismutase (SOD) and catalase (CAT)-and reduces lipid peroxidation, thereby alleviating oxidative stress and creating a cellular environment conducive to viral replication. Furthermore, BPA extended the lifespan of ZIKV-infected mosquitoes, potentially extending the period during which infected mosquitoes could transmit virus, although this remains to be directly demonstrated. Our findings uncover a mechanism by which environmental BPA exposure may influence flavivirus transmission dynamics through redox modulation in mosquitoes, highlighting the need to incorporate pollutant impacts into arboviral risk assessments.
journal: Comparative biochemistry and physiology. Toxicology & pharmacology : CBP

source_body_en: Environmental exposure to endocrine-disrupting chemicals (EDCs) is widespread, yet their influence on arthropod-borne virus transmission remains poorly understood. Here, we show that bisphenol A (BPA), a common EDC, enhances the replication of Zika virus (ZIKV) and Dengue virus (DENV) in the mosquito Aedes aegypti by modulating host oxidative stress responses. Through systematic screening of nine EDCs, BPA and dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane (DDT), significantly promoted viral replication, with BPA exhibiting the strongest effect. Chronic larval exposure to BPA led to its residual accumulation in adults and increased susceptibility to viral infection. Transcriptomic and biochemical analyses revealed that BPA upregulates antioxidant enzymes-superoxide dismutase (SOD) and catalase (CAT)-and reduces lipid peroxidation, thereby alleviating oxidative stress and creating a cellular environment conducive to viral replication. Furthermore, BPA extended the lifespan of ZIKV-infected mosquitoes, potentially extending the period during which infected mosquitoes could transmit virus, although this remains to be directly demonstrated. Our findings uncover a mechanism by which environmental BPA exposure may influence flavivirus transmission dynamics through redox modulation in mosquitoes, highlighting the need to incorporate pollutant impacts into arboviral risk assessments.

title: Clinical and epidemiological characteristics of dengue with warning signs among hospitalized children in Vietnam: A cross-sectional study.
abstract: ObjectiveDengue is a major vector-borne viral infection and a frequent cause of pediatric hospitalization in endemic settings. This study described the clinical and laboratory characteristics of hospitalized children with laboratory-confirmed dengue in northern Vietnam and examined factors associated with dengue with warning signs (DWS).MethodsThis hospital-based cross-sectional study included retrospective and prospective components. Medical records were retrospectively reviewed for eligible children aged 0-16 years admitted from 1 September to 29 December 2022, whereas eligible children in the same age group were prospectively enrolled from 30 December 2022 to 31 August 2023. DWS was classified according to the World Health Organization 2009 criteria and the Vietnamese Ministry of Health guideline. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with DWS.ResultsAmong 319 children, 126 (39.5%) met the criteria for DWS. In the multivariable analysis, age >10 years (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] 2.17, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.28-3.66; p = 0.004), urban residence (aOR 2.88, 95% CI 1.27-6.51; p = 0.011), platelet count ≤100 × 109/L (aOR 3.34, 95% CI 1.86-5.97; p < 0.001), and AST ≥100 U/L (aOR 2.83, 95% CI 1.58-5.05; p < 0.001) were independently associated with DWS. Among children with DWS, the most frequently observed warning signs were abdominal pain or tenderness (64.3%), persistent vomiting (31.7%), and mucosal bleeding (25.4%).ConclusionsDWS was common among hospitalized children with dengue at a tertiary children's hospital in northern Vietnam. Older age, urban residence, thrombocytopenia, and elevated aspartate aminotransferase may help identify children who require closer monitoring during hospitalization.
journal: The Journal of international medical research

title: Community-based health education improves knowledge of dengue hemorrhagic fever prevention: evidence from a pre–post intervention in indonesia
abstract: Background: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) remains a major public health challenge in Indonesia, requiring effective community-based preventive strategies. Health education is considered a key intervention for improving public awareness and promoting sustainable dengue prevention practices. This study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of a community health education program in improving knowledge regarding DHF prevention among residents in the working area of UPTD Puskesmas Mekar Sari. Methods: A community-based pre-experimental study using a one-group pre-test and post-test design was conducted among 37 community members. The intervention consisted of a 90-minute health education session delivered through lectures, interactive discussions, demonstrations, and educational leaflets emphasizing the PSN 3M Plus strategy. Participants completed identical knowledge questionnaires before and immediately after the intervention. Descriptive statistics were used to summarize changes in knowledge scores. Results: Before the intervention, 70.3% of participants had poor knowledge and 29.7% had fair knowledge, while none achieved a good knowledge level. Following the intervention, all participants (100%) attained the good knowledge category. The mean knowledge score increased from 8.00 to 12.89, with an average improvement of 4.89 points, indicating a substantial enhancement in participants' understanding of dengue transmission, symptoms, and prevention. Conclusion: Community-based health education effectively improved knowledge of DHF prevention and reinforced community awareness of the PSN 3M Plus strategy. Integrating regular educational activities into primary healthcare programs may strengthen community participation and contribute to sustainable dengue prevention efforts.

elements_zh.main_results: 干预前,70.3%的参与者知识水平较差,29.7%的知识水平一般,而没有人达到良好的知识水平。干预后,所有参与者(100%)均达到良好的知识水平。平均知识得分从8.00提高到12.89,平均提高了4.89分,表明参与者对登革热(传播)、症状和预防的理解有了显著增强。

title_zh: 基于社区的健康教育改善登革出血热预防知识:来自印度尼西亚一项干预前后的证据
source_body_en: Background: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) remains a major public health challenge in Indonesia, requiring effective community-based preventive strategies. Health education is considered a key intervention for improving public awareness and promoting sustainable dengue prevention practices. This study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of a community health education program in improving knowledge regarding DHF prevention among residents in the working area of UPTD Puskesmas Mekar Sari. Methods: A community-based pre-experimental study using a one-group pre-test and post-test design was conducted among 37 community members. The intervention consisted of a 90-minute health education session delivered through lectures, interactive discussions, demonstrations, and educational leaflets emphasizing the PSN 3M Plus strategy. Participants completed identical knowledge questionnaires before and immediately after the intervention. Descriptive statistics were used to summarize changes in knowledge scores. Results: Before the intervention, 70.3% of participants had poor knowledge and 29.7% had fair knowledge, while none achieved a good knowledge level. Following the intervention, all participants (100%) attained the good knowledge category. The mean knowledge score increased from 8.00 to 12.89, with an average improvement of 4.89 points, indicating a substantial enhancement in participants' understanding of dengue transmission, symptoms, and prevention. Conclusion: Community-based health education effectively improved knowledge of DHF prevention and reinforced community awareness of the PSN 3M Plus strategy. Integrating regular educational activities into primary healthcare programs may strengthen community participation and contribute to sustainable dengue prevention efforts.

title: Environmental drivers and spatiotemporal heterogeneity of dengue attack rates across selected Yemeni governorates using spatial autocorrelation and environmental discordance analysis
abstract: Dengue is environmentally sensitive, yet broad environmental conditions may not consistently correspond with reported disease burden, particularly in conflict-affected settings where surveillance capacity may vary. This ecological longitudinal study examined the spatiotemporal relationships between environmental conditions and annual reported dengue attack rates across ten Yemeni governorates from 2020 to 2024. Annual reported dengue attack rates were standardised and evaluated using temporal rankings, trajectory classifications, an exploratory Dengue Instability Index, Spearman rank correlations and Kendall’s coefficient of concordance. Environmental conditions were characterised using vegetation, surface-water, land-surface-temperature and precipitation indicators. Global and local Moran statistics were used to assess spatial dependence and environmental–epidemiological spatial associations, while principal component analysis (PCA) integrated the environmental indicators into a common environmental-profile gradient for evaluating environmental–epidemiological concordance and discordance. Marked spatial and temporal heterogeneity was observed in reported dengue burden. The highest-burden governorate changed annually, although Shabwah and Abyan maintained persistently elevated relative burdens. Hadramaut recorded the greatest temporal instability, followed by Marib and Abyan. Governorate rankings nevertheless demonstrated moderate overall concordance across the study period (Kendall’s W = 0.677, χ2(9) = 30.47, p < 0.001). Global univariate Moran’s III values were consistently negative, with significant spatial dispersion detected only in 2021 ( I = − 0.421, p < 0.05). Bivariate spatial associations between dengue and individual environmental indicators were predominantly weak, negative and temporally inconsistent. Principal component analysis showed that the first environmental component explained 67.2% of the standardised variance and represented an integrated environmental profile (a gradient from hotter, drier and less vegetated to cooler, wetter and more vegetated conditions). Among 20 governorate–year observations with above-mean reported dengue attack rates, 17 (85%) occurred under below-mean environmental-profile conditions. These findings demonstrate substantial environmental–epidemiological discordance in Yemen. Broad remotely sensed environmental conditions alone were insufficient to explain the spatial and temporal distribution of reported dengue burden. Operationally, remotely sensed environmental indicators could complement reported dengue notifications and locally available entomological and contextual data to prioritise governorates for intensified surveillance and targeted investigation.

The research employed ecological longitudinal methods, standardising dengue attack rates and evaluating them using statistical techniques such as Spearman rank correlations and Kendall’s coefficient of concordance. Environmental indicators included vegetation, surface-water, land-surface-temperature, and precipitation. The study found that environmental conditions alone could not fully explain the distribution of dengue cases, suggesting the need for integrated data approaches. These findings have implications for improving surveillance and targeting interventions in high-risk areas. However, the study's reliance on reported data introduces limitations, and the evidence is moderate due to the absence of direct causality.

abstract_zh: 登革热对环境具有敏感性,但在冲突影响的环境中,由于监测能力可能不一致,广泛环境条件可能无法始终与报告的疾病负担相对应。本生态纵向研究分析了2020年至2024年间也门十个省份的环境条件与年度报告登革热攻击率之间的时空关系。年度报告的登革热攻击率通过时间排名、轨迹分类、探索性登革热不稳定性指数、斯皮尔曼等级相关和肯德尔一致性系数进行标准化和评估。环境条件通过植被、地表水、地表温度和降水量指标进行表征。全球和局部莫兰统计量用于评估空间依赖性和环境-流行病学空间关联,而主成分分析(PCA)将环境指标整合为一个共同的环境特征梯度,以评估环境-流行病学的一致性和不一致。在报告的登革热负担中观察到显著的空间和时间异质性。最高负担省份每年变化,尽管沙布瓦和阿比安保持了持续较高的相对负担。哈德拉毛省记录了最大的时间不稳定性,其次是马里布和阿比安。然而,省份排名在整个研究期间显示出中等程度的整体一致性(肯德尔W = 0.677,χ2(9) = 30.47,p < 0.001)。全球单变量莫兰III值始终为负,仅在2021年检测到显著的空间分散(I = −0.421,p < 0.05)。登革热与单个环境指标之间的双变量空间关联主要为弱、负相关且时间不一致。主成分分析显示,第一环境成分解释了标准化方差的67.2%,代表了一个整合的环境特征(从较热、较干燥和植被较少的条件到较冷、较湿润和植被较多的条件的梯度)。在20个高于平均报告登革热攻击率的省份-年观察中,有17个(85%)发生在环境特征低于平均的条件下。这些发现表明也门存在显著的环境-流行病学不一致。仅靠广泛的遥感环境条件不足以解释报告登革热负担的空间和时间分布。在实际操作中,遥感环境指标可以补充报告的登革热通知和当地可用的媒介学和背景数据,以优先考虑需要加强监测和针对性调查的省份。

title: Gambaran Hasil Pemeriksaan Jumlah Trombosit dan Hematokrit Pada Pasien Dengue Di Puskesmas Ngaglik 1
abstract: Demam berdarah dengue, yang disebabkan oleh virus dengue, tetap menjadi tantangan kesehatan masyarakat yang signifikan di Indonesia. title_zh: 登革热患者血小板计数和血红蛋白浓度检查结果分析:Ngaglik 1卫生中心案例
source_body_en: Demam berdarah dengue, yang disebabkan oleh virus dengue, tetap menjadi tantangan kesehatan masyarakat yang signifikan di Indonesia. Tes laboratorium, seperti penghitungan trombosit dan pengukuran hematokrit, sangat penting untuk mendiagnosis dan memantau pasien demam berdarah. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menyelidiki hasil pengujian penghitungan trombosit dan hematokrit pada pasien demam berdarah di Puskesmas Ngaglik. Jenis penelitian ini adalah kuantitatif deskriptif. Pengambilan sampel total digunakan untuk mengumpulkan 135 catatan pasien demam berdarah yang diperoleh dari data laboratorium sekunder pada tahun 2025. Analisis data dilakukan menggunakan metode univariat dan disajikan dalam bentuk distribusi frekuensi dan persentase. Temuan menunjukkan bahwa mayoritas pasien demam berdarah adalah dewasa, dengan 91 responden (67,4%), dan 77 responden (57,0%) adalah laki-laki. Analisis penghitungan trombosit mengungkapkan bahwa sebagian besar pasien mengalami trombositopenia, yaitu 110 peserta (81,5%), sedangkan 25 peserta (18,5%) memiliki nilai normal. Selanjutnya, analisis kadar hematokrit menunjukkan bahwa sebagian besar pasien memiliki hematokrit dalam kisaran normal, yaitu 68 peserta (50,4%), diikuti oleh 37 peserta (27,4%) dengan hematokrit rendah dan 30 peserta (22,2%) dengan hematokrit tinggi. Penelitian ini menunjukkan bahwa trombositopenia merupakan gangguan hematologis yang paling umum terjadi pada pasien demam berdarah, sementara fluktuasi kadar hematokrit mencerminkan kondisi klinis dan tahap penyakit.

title: DENGUE (DENV)
abstract: INTRODUÇÃOA dengue é uma doença antiga, com registros históricos que antecedem a consolidação da medicina moderna.O primeiro relato de uma enfermidade clinicamente compatível com a dengue foi identificado em uma enciclopédia médica chinesa datada de 992 d.C., durante a Dinastia Northern Song.Esse compêndio reunia descrições de diversas doenças e sintomas, incluindo quadros caracterizados por febre aguda, dores corporais intensas e associação com "insetos que voam próximos à água", elementos que, à luz do conhecimento atual, são compatíveis com a infecção pelo vírus da dengue e sua transmissão por mosquitos hematófagos (Gubler, 2006).A história da dengue está intrinsecamente relacionada à de seu principal vetor, o mosquito Aedes aegypti, responsável pela disseminação do vírus em diferentes regiões do mundo.A expansão do colonialismo europeu, associada ao crescimento da indústria naval global entre os séculos XVIII e XIX, desempenhou papel central nesse processo.O aumento das rotas marítimas e o surgimento e fortalecimento de cidades portuárias criaram condições ambientais favoráveis à proliferação do vetor, como o acúmulo de água em recipientes artificiais e a intensa circulação de pessoas e mercadorias (Gubler, 2011;Messina et al., 2014).O tráfico transatlântico de pessoas escravizadas conectou a África, considerada a região de origem do Aedes aegypti e dos vírus a ele associados, a diversas partes do mundo, especialmente às Américas (Do Carmo, 2025).O mosquito e o vírus teriam sido introduzidos no continente americano principalmente por meio de ovos transportados em navios negreiros, aderidos a recipientes que acumulavam água durante as longas travessias oceânicas.Nas Américas, a primeira descrição formal do mosquito data de 1762.Contudo, relatos médicos sobre uma das principais doenças transmitidas por sua picada, a dengue, já haviam sido registrados no século XVI, quando a enfermidade era conhecida como "febre quebra-ossos", em referência às intensas dores musculares e articulares que caracterizam o quadro clínico (Gubler, 2006).Em 1780, foi descrito um surto de dengue na cidade da Filadélfia, nos Estados Unidos.No mesmo período, registros de surtos na Ásia e na África confirmaram a ampla disseminação do vetor pelos trópicos, configurando o que é considerado o primeiro surto multicontinental da doença.Ao longo dos séculos seguintes, a dengue consolidou-se como um problema recorrente em regiões tropicais e subtropicais, acompanhando a expansão urbana, o crescimento populacional e as transformações ambientais (Gubler, 2006;Messina et al., 2014).No Brasil, o primeiro registro documentado de dengue ocorreu em 1916, na cidade de São Paulo.Entretanto, apenas décadas depois o país enfrentaria uma epidemia reconhecida da doença.Em 1981, casos de febre foram notificados em Boa Vista, no estado de Roraima, e posteriormente confirmados como dengue por virologistas do Instituto Evandro Chagas (IEC).Entre julho de 1981 e agosto de 1982, aproximadamente 11 mil pessoas foram infectadas pelos sorotipos 1 e 4 do vírus da dengue.Evidências epidemiológicas indicam que o vírus tenha ingressado no território brasileiro por via terrestre, com origem no Caribe e no norte da América do Sul (Teixeira; Barreto; Guerra, 2009; Brasil, 2022).Nesse período inicial, não houve disseminação nacional da doença, uma vez que o Aedes aegypti ainda não se encontrava amplamente disperso no país.Ademais, as ações de controle vetorial implementadas contribuíram para a contenção do surto na região, sem impedir, contudo, a manutenção do vetor em outras áreas do país.No entanto, alguns anos depois, em 30 de abril de 1986, os primeiros casos de dengue foram registrados em Nova Iguaçu, no estado do Rio de Janeiro, marcando o início de um novo ciclo de expansão da doença no território nacional.Diante desse cenário, o Centro de Estudos da Escola Nacional de Saúde Pública da Fundação Oswaldo Cruz (Ensp/Fiocruz) promoveu um debate acadêmico sobre a dengue, posteriormente transcrito e publicado em um dossiê

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the historical context and spread of dengue virus, particularly focusing on its introduction to Brazil and the role of the Aedes aegypti mosquito in its dissemination. Dengue is an ancient disease with historical records dating back to the 10th century, and its transmission has been closely linked to the movement of the vector and the virus across continents.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a historical review focusing on the spread of dengue virus and its vector, Aedes aegypti, across different regions, including Brazil. It examines the introduction of the virus to Brazil in the early 20th century and the subsequent epidemiological patterns observed in the 1980s.
analysis.methods: The study utilized historical records, epidemiological data, and references to prior research to trace the introduction and spread of dengue virus in Brazil. It analyzed the role of colonialism, maritime trade, and the movement of the Aedes aegypti mosquito in facilitating the virus's dissemination.
analysis.main_results: The first documented case of dengue in Brazil occurred in 1916 in São Paulo, but the country did not experience a recognized epidemic until 1981 in Boa Vista, Roraima. By 1982, approximately 11,000 people were infected with DENV-1 and DENV-4. The virus was later introduced to Rio de Janeiro in 1986, marking the beginning of a new phase of its spread in the country.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the introduction of dengue to Brazil was influenced by historical factors such as colonial expansion and maritime trade, which facilitated the spread of the Aedes aegypti mosquito and the virus. This study provides a historical perspective on the epidemiology of dengue in Brazil.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the historical and ecological factors that contributed to the spread of dengue in Brazil, offering insights into the disease's epidemiological patterns and the importance of vector control in preventing outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on historical and epidemiological records, which may be subject to gaps or inaccuracies. However, the evidence is supported by multiple references, including documented cases and historical accounts, providing a moderate level of confidence in its conclusions.

analysis.summary_en: This study provides a historical overview of dengue virus and its spread, particularly in Brazil. It traces the origins of dengue to ancient times, with the first documented case in Brazil occurring in 1916. The virus was later confirmed in 1981, with approximately 11,000 infections reported in Roraima. The introduction of dengue to Brazil is linked to the movement of the Aedes aegypti mosquito, facilitated by colonial expansion and maritime trade. The study emphasizes the role of vector control in managing outbreaks and offers a historical perspective on the epidemiology of dengue in the country. While the evidence is based on historical records, it is supported by multiple references, providing a moderate level of confidence in its conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨 登革病毒 的历史背景及其传播,特别是其引入巴西的过程以及埃及伊蚊(Aedes aegypti)在传播中的作用。登革热是一种历史悠久的疾病,其历史记录可追溯至10世纪,且其传播与 传播 的传播及病毒在大陆间的移动密切相关。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项历史回顾,重点分析 登革病毒 及其媒介 Aedes aegypti 在不同地区的传播,包括巴西。研究探讨了该病毒在20世纪初传入巴西的情况,以及1980年代在该国观察到的流行病学模式。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究利用历史记录、流行病学数据和先前研究的参考文献,追踪登革热病毒在巴西的引入和传播过程。研究分析了殖民扩张、海上贸易以及埃及伊蚊传播的动态如何促进病毒的扩散。
elements_zh.main_results: 巴西首个有记录的登革热病例出现在1916年,地点是圣保罗市。然而,该国直到1981年罗赖马州的博阿维斯塔市才出现公认的登革热疫情。到1982年,大约有11,000人感染了登革病毒1型和4型。随后,该病毒于1986年传入里约热内卢州的新伊瓜苏市,标志着其在巴西国内传播进入了一个新的阶段。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,登革热传入巴西受到历史因素的影响,如殖民扩张和海上贸易,这些因素促进了埃及伊蚊和病毒的传播。本研究为登革热在巴西的传播提供了历史视角。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果突显了历史和生态因素在巴西登革热传播中的作用,为理解该疾病的流行病学模式提供了见解,并强调了埃及伊蚊控制在预防疾病传播中的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于历史和流行病学记录,这些记录可能存在缺失或不准确之处。然而,研究结果得到了多个参考文献的支持,包括有记录的病例和历史记载,从而对其结论提供了中等程度的可信度。

title_zh: 登革热(DENV)
source_body_en: INTRODUÇÃOA dengue é uma doença antiga, com registros históricos que antecedem a consolidação da medicina moderna.O primeiro relato de uma enfermidade clinicamente compatível com a dengue foi identificado em uma enciclopédia médica chinesa datada de 992 d.C., durante a Dinastia Northern Song.Esse compêndio reunia descrições de diversas doenças e sintomas, incluindo quadros caracterizados por febre aguda, dores corporais intensas e associação com "insetos que voam próximos à água", elementos que, à luz do conhecimento atual, são compatíveis com a infecção pelo vírus da dengue e sua transmissão por mosquitos hematófagos (Gubler, 2006).A história da dengue está intrinsecamente relacionada à de seu principal vetor, o mosquito Aedes aegypti, responsável pela disseminação do vírus em diferentes regiões do mundo.A expansão do colonialismo europeu, associada ao crescimento da indústria naval global entre os séculos XVIII e XIX, desempenhou papel central nesse processo.O aumento das rotas marítimas e o surgimento e fortalecimento de cidades portuárias criaram condições ambientais favoráveis à proliferação do vetor, como o acúmulo de água em recipientes artificiais e a intensa circulação de pessoas e mercadorias (Gubler, 2011;Messina et al., 2014).O tráfico transatlântico de pessoas escravizadas conectou a África, considerada a região de origem do Aedes aegypti e dos vírus a ele associados, a diversas partes do mundo, especialmente às Américas (Do Carmo, 2025).O mosquito e o vírus teriam sido introduzidos no continente americano principalmente por meio de ovos transportados em navios negreiros, aderidos a recipientes que acumulavam água durante as longas travessias oceânicas.Nas Américas, a primeira descrição formal do mosquito data de 1762.Contudo, relatos médicos sobre uma das principais doenças transmitidas por sua picada, a dengue, já haviam sido registrados no século XVI, quando a enfermidade era conhecida como "febre quebra-ossos", em referência às intensas dores musculares e articulares que caracterizam o quadro clínico (Gubler, 2006).Em 1780, foi descrito um surto de dengue na cidade da Filadélfia, nos Estados Unidos.No mesmo período, registros de surtos na Ásia e na África confirmaram a ampla disseminação do vetor pelos trópicos, configurando o que é considerado o primeiro surto multicontinental da doença.Ao longo dos séculos seguintes, a dengue consolidou-se como um problema recorrente em regiões tropicais e subtropicais, acompanhando a expansão urbana, o crescimento populacional e as transformações ambientais (Gubler, 2006;Messina et al., 2014).No Brasil, o primeiro registro documentado de dengue ocorreu em 1916, na cidade de São Paulo.Entretanto, apenas décadas depois o país enfrentaria uma epidemia reconhecida da doença.Em 1981, casos de febre foram notificados em Boa Vista, no estado de Roraima, e posteriormente confirmados como dengue por virologistas do Instituto Evandro Chagas (IEC).Entre julho de 1981 e agosto de 1982, aproximadamente 11 mil pessoas foram infectadas pelos sorotipos 1 e 4 do vírus da dengue.Evidências epidemiológicas indicam que o vírus tenha ingressado no território brasileiro por via terrestre, com origem no Caribe e no norte da América do Sul (Teixeira; Barreto; Guerra, 2009; Brasil, 2022).Nesse período inicial, não houve disseminação nacional da doença, uma vez que o Aedes aegypti ainda não se encontrava amplamente disperso no país.Ademais, as ações de controle vetorial implementadas contribuíram para a contenção do surto na região, sem impedir, contudo, a manutenção do vetor em outras áreas do país.No entanto, alguns anos depois, em 30 de abril de 1986, os primeiros casos de dengue foram registrados em Nova Iguaçu, no estado do Rio de Janeiro, marcando o início de um novo ciclo de expansão da doença no território nacional.Diante desse cenário, o Centro de Estudos da Escola Nacional de Saúde Pública da Fundação analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨 登革病毒 的历史背景及其传播,特别是其引入巴西的过程以及埃及伊蚊(Aedes aegypti)在传播中的作用。登革热是一种历史悠久的疾病,其历史记录可追溯至10世纪,且其传播与 传播 的传播及病毒在大陆间的移动密切相关。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项历史回顾,重点分析 登革病毒 及其媒介 Aedes aegypti 在不同地区的传播,包括巴西。研究探讨了该病毒在20世纪初传入巴西的情况,以及1980年代在该国观察到的流行病学模式。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究利用历史记录、流行病学数据和先前研究的参考文献,追踪登革热病毒在巴西的引入和传播过程。研究分析了殖民扩张、海上贸易以及埃及伊蚊传播的动态如何促进病毒的扩散。
analysis_zh.main_results: 巴西首个有记录的登革热病例出现在1916年,地点是圣保罗市。然而,该国直到1981年罗赖马州的博阿维斯塔市才出现公认的登革热疫情。到1982年,大约有11,000人感染了登革病毒1型和4型。随后,该病毒于1986年传入里约热内卢州的新伊瓜苏市,标志着其在巴西国内传播进入了一个新的阶段。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,登革热传入巴西受到历史因素的影响,如殖民扩张和海上贸易,这些因素促进了埃及伊蚊和病毒的传播。本研究为登革热在巴西的传播提供了历史视角。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果突显了历史和生态因素在巴西登革热传播中的作用,为理解该疾病的流行病学模式提供了见解,并强调了埃及伊蚊控制在预防疾病传播中的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于历史和流行病学记录,这些记录可能存在缺失或不准确之处。然而,研究结果得到了多个参考文献的支持,包括有记录的病例和历史记载,从而对其结论提供了中等程度的可信度。

abstract: Abstract Dengue pathogenesis depends on a conformational rearrangement of the envelope glycoprotein (pE) induced by low pH. However, how pH and temperature cooperate to destabilize the dimeric form of the pE, a fundamental step that enables the formation of the fusion-active trimer, remains unclear. Here, we investigate this synergy for Dengue serotypes of greatest medical relevance, DENV-2 and DENV-3. All–atom molecular dynamics simulations were performed on the microsecond scale, at 28 °C, 37 °C, and 40 °C under pH 5, 6, and 7 using CHARMM36m force fields and complemented by extended coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations for the DENV-2 system at 37 °C and pH 5, and for the DENV-3 system at 28 °C and pH 5, and at 37 °C and pH 7. Our simulations suggest that increasing the temperature from 28 to 37 °C tends to expand the conformational space at neutral pH, potentially weakening dimer integrity through modulation of the interfacial interaction network. Acidification appears to amplify this effect in a serotype–specific manner: in our simulations DENV-2 required pH 5, while DENV-3 responded at pH 6. Additionally, distance and principal component analyses revealed an asymmetric dissociation pathway, termed the “compensatory embrace”, observed in both all-atom and coarse-grained models. Structural analyses further highlighted the differences in histidine distribution between the serotypes. Moreover, interaction mapping at 37 °C identified candidate interfacial contacts that may act as pH-sensitive latches, maintaining stability at pH 7 but breaking upon acidification. Collectively, these results suggest a potential hierarchy of physicochemical triggers that may contribute to the conversion of dimer into fusion-competent monomers. These interfacial hotspots and the “compensatory embrace” constitute structurally informed targets that, pending validation under native virion conditions, may guide the rational design of antivirals and immunogens, underscoring the value of long-time scale molecular dynamics simulations as a hypothesis-generating tool in drug discovery.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand how pH and temperature interact to destabilize the dimeric form of the Dengue virus envelope glycoprotein, a critical step in viral pathogenesis. Dengue pathogenesis depends on a conformational rearrangement of the envelope glycoprotein (pE) induced by low pH.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used all-atom molecular dynamics simulations on Dengue serotypes DENV-2 and DENV-3, focusing on their envelope glycoprotein dimeric form under varying pH and temperature conditions. Simulations were conducted at 28 °C, 37 °C, and 40 °C under pH 5, 6, and 7.
analysis.methods: The researchers performed all-atom molecular dynamics simulations using CHARMM36m force fields and extended coarse-grained simulations for DENV-2 and DENV-3 at specific conditions. Distance and principal component analyses were used to identify dissociation pathways.
analysis.main_results: Simulations showed that increasing temperature from 28 to 37 °C expanded the conformational space at neutral pH, potentially weakening dimer integrity. Acidification amplified this effect in a serotype-specific manner, with DENV-2 responding at pH 5 and DENV-3 at pH 6. Distance and principal component analyses revealed an asymmetric dissociation pathway, termed the "compensatory embrace", observed in both all-atom and coarse-grained models.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The results suggest a potential hierarchy of physicochemical triggers that may contribute to the conversion of dimer into fusion-competent monomers. Structural analyses highlighted differences in histidine distribution between the serotypes.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings provide structurally informed targets for the rational design of antivirals and immunogens, which could aid in the development of new therapeutic strategies against Dengue virus.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on simulations and does not include experimental validation under native virion conditions. The evidence is moderate as it relies on computational models rather than direct biological assays.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the synergistic effects of pH and temperature on the destabilization of the dimeric form of the Dengue virus envelope glycoprotein, a key step in viral pathogenesis. Using all-atom and coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations, the researchers explored how varying pH and temperature conditions affect the conformational stability of DENV-2 and DENV-3. The results indicate that temperature increases at neutral pH may weaken dimer integrity, with acidification amplifying this effect in a serotype-specific manner. An asymmetric dissociation pathway, termed the "compensatory embrace", was identified. These findings highlight potential physicochemical triggers for dimer-to-monomer conversion and suggest structural targets for antiviral and immunogen development. However, the study is limited to computational models and lacks experimental validation under native virion conditions, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解pH和温度如何相互作用以破坏登革病毒包膜糖蛋白的二聚体形式,这是病毒发病机制的关键步骤。登革病毒发病机制依赖于包膜糖蛋白(pE)在低pH诱导下的构象重排。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用全原子分子动力学模拟,针对登革病毒血清型DENV-2和DENV-3,研究它们在不同pH和温度条件下的包膜糖蛋白二聚体形式。模拟在28 °C、37 °C和40 °C下进行,pH为5、6和7。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用CHARMM36m力场进行了全原子分子动力学模拟,并针对DENV-2和DENV-3在特定条件下进行了扩展粗粒度模拟。通过距离分析和主成分分析来识别解离路径。
elements_zh.main_results: 模拟结果显示,温度从28 °C升高到37 °C时,在中性pH条件下会扩大构象空间,可能通过调节界面相互作用网络而削弱二聚体的完整性。酸化以血清型特异性方式放大了这一效应,DENV-2在pH 5时响应,而DENV-3在pH 6时响应。距离分析和主成分分析揭示了一种不对称的解离路径,称为“补偿性拥抱”,在全原子和粗粒度模型中均观察到。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些结果表明可能存在一种物理化学触发因素的层次结构,这可能有助于二聚体转化为具有融合能力的单体。结构分析突出了不同血清型之间组氨酸分布的差异。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为抗病毒药物和免疫原的合理设计提供了结构导向的目标,可能有助于开发针对登革病毒的新治疗策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于模拟,未包括在原生病毒颗粒条件下的实验验证。证据强度中等,因为它依赖于计算模型而非直接的生物实验。

title_zh: pH和温度对登革病毒包膜二聚体的协同效应:来自微秒分子动力学模拟的见解
source_body_en: Abstract Dengue pathogenesis depends on a conformational rearrangement of the envelope glycoprotein (pE) induced by low pH. However, how pH and temperature cooperate to destabilize the dimeric form of the pE, a fundamental step that enables the formation of the fusion-active trimer, remains unclear. Here, we investigate this synergy for Dengue serotypes of greatest medical relevance, DENV-2 and DENV-3. All–atom molecular dynamics simulations were performed on the microsecond scale, at 28 °C, 37 °C, and 40 °C under pH 5, 6, and 7 using CHARMM36m force fields and complemented by extended coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations for the DENV-2 system at 37 °C and pH 5, and for the DENV-3 system at 28 °C and pH 5, and at 37 °C and pH 7. Our simulations suggest that increasing the temperature from 28 to 37 °C tends to expand the conformational space at neutral pH, potentially weakening dimer integrity through modulation of the interfacial interaction network. Acidification appears to amplify this effect in a serotype–specific manner: in our simulations DENV-2 required pH 5, while DENV-3 responded at pH 6. Additionally, distance and principal component analyses revealed an asymmetric dissociation pathway, termed the “compensatory embrace”, observed in both all-atom and coarse-grained models. Structural analyses further highlighted the differences in histidine distribution between the serotypes. Moreover, interaction mapping at 37 °C identified candidate interfacial contacts that may act as pH-sensitive latches, maintaining stability at pH 7 but breaking upon acidification. Collectively, these results suggest a potential hierarchy of physicochemical triggers that may contribute to the conversion of dimer into fusion-competent monomers. These interfacial hotspots and the “compensatory embrace” constitute structurally informed targets that, pending validation under native virion conditions, may guide the rational design of antivirals and immunogens, underscoring the value of long-time scale molecular dynamics simulations as a hypothesis-generating tool in drug discovery.
abstract_zh: 摘要 登革病毒发病机制依赖于包膜糖蛋白(pE)在低pH诱导下的构象重排。然而,pH和温度如何协同作用以破坏pE的二聚体形式,这是形成融合活性三聚体的关键步骤,目前尚不清楚。在此研究中,我们针对具有最大医学意义的登革病毒血清型,DENV-2和DENV-3,探讨了这种协同效应。使用CHARMM36m力场,在28 °C、37 °C和40 °C下,pH 5、6和7条件下进行了全原子分子动力学模拟,并通过扩展粗粒度分子动力学模拟补充了DENV-2系统在37 °C和pH 5下的模拟,以及DENV-3系统在28 °C和pH 5、37 °C和pH 7下的模拟。我们的模拟结果表明,温度从28 °C升高到37 °C时,在中性pH条件下会扩大构象空间,可能通过调节界面相互作用网络而削弱二聚体的完整性。酸化似乎以血清型特异性方式放大了这一效应:在我们的模拟中,DENV-2需要pH 5,而DENV-3则在pH 6时响应。此外,距离分析和主成分分析揭示了一种不对称的解离路径,称为“补偿性拥抱”,在全原子和粗粒度模型中均观察到。结构分析进一步突出了不同血清型之间组氨酸分布的差异。此外,在37 °C下的相互作用图谱识别出了一些候选的界面接触点,这些接触点可能作为pH敏感的闩锁,维持在pH 7时的稳定性,但在酸化条件下会断裂。总体而言,这些结果表明可能存在一种物理化学触发因素的层次结构,这可能有助于二聚体转化为具有融合能力的单体。这些界面热点以及“补偿性拥抱”构成了结构导向的目标,若在原生病毒颗粒条件下得到验证,可能有助于抗病毒药物和免疫原的合理设计,强调了在药物发现中长时尺度分子动力学模拟作为假设生成工具的价值。

title: Dengue and Chikungunya Seroprevalence in an Urban Low-Income Cohort in Delhi: A Cross-Sectional and Nested Longitudinal Study
abstract: Objectives: The aim of this study was to ascertain the seroprevalence and determinants of dengue virus (DENV) and chikungunya virus (CHIKV) seropositivity in Delhi, India. Methods: This cross-sectional serosurvey with a nested longitudinal immunological sub-study was conducted in an urban resettlement and slum settlement in the North-East district of Delhi in individuals aged ≥2 years. Dengue and Chikungunya virus IgG antibodies were screened using indirect enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), and a longitudinal subset of 100 paired IgG-seropositive samples was further characterized via a plaque reduction neutralization test (μPRNT50) to evaluate changes in functional neutralization over time. Results: A total of 752 participants, including 56.65% female participants, were included in the study. Of the participants studied, 81.91% (95% CI: 78.97, 84.60; n = 616) were positive for IgG antibodies against DENV, and 28.32% (95% CI: 25.13, 31.69; n = 213) were positive for CHIKV IgG antibodies. μPRNT50 confirmed stable, near-universal CHIKV neutralization (97% baseline, 98% endline). However, DENV neutralizing antibody showed a significant contraction for DENV-3 (79% baseline, 60% endline) and DENV-4 (69% baseline, 60% endline), while DENV-1 (76%) and DENV-2 (77% to 80%) antibodies remained stable. Individuals living in households with screened windows had significantly lower odds of contracting DENV infection (AOR: 0.36; 95% CI: 0.21, 0.61) and CHIKV infection (AOR: 0.63; 95% CI: 0.43, 0.90) compared with those living in households without screened windows. Further, individuals from households with uncovered containers with stagnant water had 50% higher odds of CHIKV infection than those without such containers (AOR: 1.55; 95% CI: 1.05, 2.29). Conclusions: This study revealed a high burden of DENV and CHIKV exposure in this high-risk urban population. While neutralization remained stable for CHIKV, DENV-1, and DENV-2, waning DENV-3 and DENV-4 antibodies suggest differential serotype-specific immunity in the participants.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the seroprevalence and determinants of dengue virus (DENV) and chikungunya virus (CHIKV) exposure in an urban low-income cohort in Delhi, India. A cross-sectional serosurvey with a nested longitudinal sub-study was conducted among individuals aged ≥2 years. DENV IgG antibodies were detected in 81.91% of participants, while CHIKV IgG antibodies were found in 28.32%. μPRNT50 revealed stable CHIKV neutralization but significant waning of DENV-3 and DENV-4 antibodies over time. The study highlights the importance of environmental factors in DENV and CHIKV transmission. The findings suggest the need for targeted surveillance and prevention strategies in high-risk urban populations. However, the study's cross-sectional design limits the confidence in its conclusions, and the evidence is considered moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在确定印度德里地区登革病毒(DENV)和寨卡病毒(CHIKV)的血清流行率及其决定因素。该研究的动机是了解这些病毒在城市低收入人群中的负担。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究在印度德里东北区的一个城市安置点和贫民窟中开展,针对年龄≥2年的个体进行横断面血清学调查,并嵌套纵向免疫学子研究。本研究共纳入752名参与者,其中女性占56.65%。
elements_zh.methods: 通过间接酶联免疫吸附试验(ELISA)筛查登革病毒和寨卡病毒的IgG抗体,并对100对IgG血清阳性样本进行纵向分析,通过斑块减少中和试验(μPRNT50)评估随时间变化的功能性中和能力。
elements_zh.main_results: Of the participants studied, 81.91% (95% CI: 78.97, 84.60; n = 616) were positive for IgG antibodies against DENV, and 28.32% (95% CI: 25.13, 31.69; n = 213) were positive for CHIKV IgG antibodies. μPRNT50 confirmed stable, near-universal CHIKV neutralization (97% baseline, 98% endline). elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,登革病毒和寨卡病毒的高血清流行率表明该人群中存在显著的暴露。他们指出,DENV-3和DENV-4抗体相比DENV-1和DENV-2抗体的差异性下降,表明参与者中存在不同的血清型特异性免疫反应。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,需要在城市低收入地区采取针对性的监测和预防策略,特别是关注影响登革病毒和寨卡病毒传播的环境因素。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其横断面设计,可能无法准确捕捉纵向趋势。由于基于单一时点和嵌套纵向子集,证据强度中等。

title: Platelet Indices in Dengue Patients Stratified by Platelet Count in a Tertiary Care Hospital of Khulna City of Bangladesh
abstract: Background: Dengue fever is a major public health problem in tropical countries and is commonly associated with hematological abnormalities, particularly thrombocytopenia. Platelet indices such as mean platelet volume (MPV), platelet distribution width (PDW), and plateletcrit (PCT) are routinely available parameters that may help in assessing disease severity and monitoring patients with dengue infection.Objective: The purpose of the present study was to evaluate platelet indices in dengue patients stratified according to platelet count in a tertiary care hospital in Khulna, Bangladesh. Methodology: This cross-sectional study was conducted at Gazi Medical College Hospital, Khulna, Bangladesh from August to December 2025. A total of 100 serologically confirmed dengue patients aged more than or equal to 18 years were enrolled. Patients were categorized into groups based on platelet count, such as less than 20,000/cumm, 20,000 to 50,000/cumm, 50,000 to 100,000/cumm, 100,000 to 150,000/cumm, and more than 150,000/cumm. Hematological parameters, including platelet count, MPV, PDW, and PCT, were obtained using an automated hematology analyzer. Data were analyzed using SPSS version 21. As data were non-normally distributed, results were expressed as median (IQR), and comparisons among groups were performed using the Kruskal–Wallis test. Results: Among the 100 patients, 55.0% were male and 45% female. The majority of the patients were recorded in the 31 to 40 years age group (28.0%), followed closely by the 21 to 30 years age group (26.0%). Most cases were dengue fever (79.0%), followed by dengue hemorrhagic fever (18.0%) and dengue shock syndrome (3.0%). The median platelet count was 57,500/cumm (IQR: 30,000–89,750). Plateletcrit showed a highly significant association with platelet count (p < 0.001), with progressively increasing values across higher platelet count groups. In contrast, MPV (p = 0.306) and PDW (p = 0.302) did not show significant associations with platelet count. Conclusion: Among the platelet indices, plateletcrit demonstrated a strong and significant correlation with platelet count in dengue patients. Plateletcrit may serve as a useful adjunct parameter in monitoring thrombocytopenia and disease progression in dengue infection. Bangladesh Journal of Infectious Diseases, June 2026;13(1):360-366

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to evaluate platelet indices in dengue patients stratified by platelet count in a tertiary care hospital in Khulna, Bangladesh. A cross-sectional design was used, enrolling 100 serologically confirmed dengue patients aged 18 years or older. Platelet indices such as mean platelet volume (MPV), platelet distribution width (PDW), and plateletcrit (PCT) were measured using an automated hematology analyzer. The median platelet count was 57,500/cumm (IQR: 30,000–89,750), with 79% of cases classified as dengue fever, 18% as dengue hemorrhagic fever, and 3% as dengue shock syndrome. Plateletcrit showed a highly significant association with platelet count (p < 0.001), while MPV and PDW did not. The authors concluded that plateletcrit is a strong and significant correlate of platelet count in dengue patients, suggesting its potential utility in monitoring disease progression. The study is limited by its cross-sectional design and the absence of detailed limitations or evidence strength assessment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热是热带国家的主要公共卫生问题,常与血液学异常,特别是血小板减少症相关。本研究的目的是评估孟加拉国库尔纳市三级医院中按血小板计数分层的登革热患者的血小板指标。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本横断面研究于2025年8月至12月在孟加拉国库尔纳市的Gazi Medical College Hospital进行。共纳入100例血清学确诊的登革热患者,年龄均大于或等于18岁。根据血小板计数将患者分为不同组别,如每微升少于20,000个、20,000至50,000个、50,000至100,000个、100,000至150,000个以及超过150,000个。
elements_zh.methods: 使用自动化血液分析仪获取血液学参数,包括血小板计数、平均血小板体积(MPV)、血小板分布宽度(PDW)和血小板压积(PCT)。数据使用SPSS 21版进行分析。由于数据呈非正态分布,结果以中位数(IQR)表示,组间比较采用Kruskal–Wallis检验。
elements_zh.main_results: 在100名患者中,55.0%为男性,45%为女性。大多数患者年龄在31至40岁之间(28.0%),其次是21至30岁(26.0%)。大多数病例为登革热(79.0%),其次是登革出血热(18.0%)和登革休克综合征(3.0%)。血小板计数的中位数为57,500/cumm(IQR:30,000–89,750)。血小板压积与血小板计数之间存在高度显著关联(p < 0.001),在血小板计数较高的组别中呈现逐渐增加的趋势。相比之下,MPV(p = 0.306)和PDW(p = 0.302)与血小板计数之间未显示出显著关联。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在血小板指标中,血小板压积在登革热患者中与血小板计数表现出强而显著的相关性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 血小板压积可能作为监测登革热感染中血小板减少症和疾病进展的有用辅助参数。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告局限性或证据强度。

title_zh: 孟加拉国库尔纳市三级医院中登革热患者血小板指标按血小板计数分层分析
source_body_en: Background: Dengue fever is a major public health problem in tropical countries and is commonly associated with hematological abnormalities, particularly thrombocytopenia. Platelet indices such as mean platelet volume (MPV), platelet distribution width (PDW), and plateletcrit (PCT) are routinely available parameters that may help in assessing disease severity and monitoring patients with dengue infection.Objective: The purpose of the present study was to evaluate platelet indices in dengue patients stratified according to platelet count in a tertiary care hospital in Khulna, Bangladesh. Methodology: This cross-sectional study was conducted at Gazi Medical College Hospital, Khulna, Bangladesh from August to December 2025. A total of 100 serologically confirmed dengue patients aged more than or equal to 18 years were enrolled. Patients were categorized into groups based on platelet count, such as less than 20,000/cumm, 20,000 to 50,000/cumm, 50,000 to 100,000/cumm, 100,000 to 150,000/cumm, and more than 150,000/cumm. Hematological parameters, including platelet count, MPV, PDW, and PCT, were obtained using an automated hematology analyzer. Data were analyzed using SPSS version 21. As data were non-normally distributed, results were expressed as median (IQR), and comparisons among groups were performed using the Kruskal–Wallis test. Results: Among the 100 patients, 55.0% were male and 45% female. The majority of the patients were recorded in the 31 to 40 years age group (28.0%), followed closely by the 21 to 30 years age group (26.0%). Most cases were dengue fever (79.0%), followed by dengue hemorrhagic fever (18.0%) and dengue shock syndrome (3.0%). The median platelet count was 57,500/cumm (IQR: 30,000–89,750). Plateletcrit showed a highly significant association with platelet count (p < 0.001), with progressively increasing values across higher platelet count groups. In contrast, MPV (p = 0.306) and PDW (p = 0.302) did not show significant associations with platelet count. Conclusion: Among the platelet indices, plateletcrit demonstrated a strong and significant correlation with platelet count in dengue patients. Plateletcrit may serve as a useful adjunct parameter in monitoring thrombocytopenia and disease progression in dengue infection. Bangladesh Journal of Infectious Diseases, June 2026;13(1):360-366

title: Computational shielding of dengue viral prefusion with permeable cyclic-minipeptides
abstract: Permeable cyclic-minipeptide-conformer candidates have been computationally cogenerated to shield the protected prefusionloops (FL) of dengue flavivirus (DENV). The objective was to prevent the pH-dependent dissociation events that trigger flavivirus fusion/ infectivity by exposing the FL highlyconserved sequences to homotrimer fusioncompetent conformations. For that, hundreds of BoltzGen candidates were co-generated targeting a prefusion minimized DENV envelope AB heterodimer (minEAB) model including both EA-protective and EB-FL sequences. The advantages of the newly cogenerated top-affinity nanoMolar candidates include possible bypassing of antibody-related enhancements, low antigenicity, easy chemical synthesis, and strong environmentalphysiological stability. Additionally, top-affinity parents were mutated to derive membranepermeable candidates conserving cyclization, minEAB targets and high-affinities. A few membrane-permeable candidates may serve for in vitro and animal-model experimentallyguided validations of inhibition of DENV fusion and infection.

analysis.summary_en: This abstract describes a computational effort to design permeable cyclic‐minipeptide candidates that shield dengue virus prefusion loops, aiming to block pH‐triggered fusion. Hundreds of candidates were generated against a minimized DENV envelope model, and high‐affinity parents were mutated to retain target binding while gaining membrane permeability. The authors propose that these nanomolar‐affinity peptides could avoid antibody‐dependent enhancement, be low‐antigenic, synthetically accessible, and stable, offering a novel strategy for dengue inhibition. However, the report provides no experimental or quantitative results, limiting confidence in the findings and indicating that further in‐vitro and animal studies are needed to validate efficacy.

abstract_zh: 针对登革病毒(DENV)的保护性前融合环(FL)结构,已计算生成了具有渗透性的环状微型肽构象候选物。目标是通过将高度保守的FL序列暴露于同源三聚体融合活性构象,防止触发黄病毒融合/感染的pH依赖性解离事件。为此,生成了数百个BoltzGen候选物,针对包含EA保护性和EB-FL序列的前融合最小化DENV包膜AB异二聚体(minEAB)模型。新生成的高亲和力纳摩尔候选物的优势包括可能绕过抗体依赖性增强、低抗原性、易于化学合成以及在环境生理条件下具有强稳定性。此外,通过突变高亲和力母体肽,生成了保留环化、minEAB靶点和高亲和力的渗透性候选物。少数渗透性候选物可用于体外和动物模型实验指导下的登革病毒融合和感染抑制验证。

title: Computational Identification of Dengue-Associated Comorbidities and Key Regulatory Genes from Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cell Transcriptomes
abstract: Dengue fever remains a major health concern, and variation in host immune responses contributes to differences in clinical severity. This study computationally investigated peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) transcriptomes to identify highly expressed sample-specific genes, potential dengue-associated comorbidities, and key regulatory genes across dengue fever, dengue haemorrhagic fever, dengue with plasma leakage, and dengue without plasma leakage. Publicly available RNA-seq datasets were collected, processed, and integrated. Highly expressed sample-specific genes were identified after excluding housekeeping genes, followed by Gene Ontology, KEGG pathway, and Disease Ontology enrichment analyses. Protein–protein interaction networks were then used to identify hub genes associated with enriched disease terms. The analyses identified BCL2, MYC, TNF, and TYMS as key genes linking the examined dengue conditions with distinct disease categories. Leukaemia-related disease terms were prominent in dengue fever and dengue haemorrhagic fever, with BCL2 identified in both conditions and MYC additionally identified in dengue haemorrhagic fever. In dengue with plasma leakage, TNF was associated with rheumatic and autoimmune disease terms. In dengue without plasma leakage, TNF was linked with rheumatic and tuberculosis-related terms, while TYMS was associated with multiple myeloma-related molecular patterns. These findings describe condition-specific gene–disease overlaps in PBMC transcriptomes and provide computational candidates for further investigation. Experimental and clinical validation is required before these predicted associations can be considered for diagnostic or therapeutic application.
journal: Asian Journal of Research in Infectious Diseases

source_body_en: Dengue fever remains a major health concern, and variation in host immune responses contributes to differences in clinical severity. This study computationally investigated peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) transcriptomes to identify highly expressed sample-specific genes, potential dengue-associated comorbidities, and key regulatory genes across dengue fever, dengue haemorrhagic fever, dengue with plasma leakage, and dengue without plasma leakage. Publicly available RNA-seq datasets were collected, processed, and integrated. Highly expressed sample-specific genes were identified after excluding housekeeping genes, followed by Gene Ontology, KEGG pathway, and Disease Ontology enrichment analyses. Protein–protein interaction networks were then used to identify hub genes associated with enriched disease terms. The analyses identified BCL2, MYC, TNF, and TYMS as key genes linking the examined dengue conditions with distinct disease categories. Leukaemia-related disease terms were prominent in dengue fever and dengue haemorrhagic fever, with BCL2 identified in both conditions and MYC additionally identified in dengue haemorrhagic fever. In dengue with plasma leakage, TNF was associated with rheumatic and autoimmune disease terms. In dengue without plasma leakage, TNF was linked with rheumatic and tuberculosis-related terms, while TYMS was associated with multiple myeloma-related molecular patterns. These findings describe condition-specific gene–disease overlaps in PBMC transcriptomes and provide computational candidates for further investigation. Experimental and clinical validation is required before these predicted associations can be considered for diagnostic or therapeutic application.

title: Experiences of Dengue Patients and Healthcare Professionals in Public Hospitals of Rizal, Philippines
abstract: Dengue is a disease that plagues the Philippines, and the experiences of dengue patients and healthcare workers in public hospitals in Rizal in response to the rising dengue cases remain to be further investigated. This study seeks to gather information through interviews with healthcare professionals and dengue patients from public hospitals in Rizal, Philippines to interpret and consider their experiences to improve the effectiveness, efficiency, and quality of treating dengue cases. A qualitative study was conducted through semi-structured interviews of three dengue patients and three healthcare workers obtained through snowball sampling. A thematic analysis was used to synthesize the data. It was found that patients had experiences with problems due to understaffing, difficult accommodations, and the lasting effects of the disease on their mental and physical health. Healthcare workers were shown to suffer from severe workload due to the high number of patients, difficulties communicating with patients, and insufficient facilities. This sheds light on the experiences of each group and the aspects of healthcare in public hospitals of Rizal that may be improved, such as budget allocation, creating more tertiary hospitals, improving work conditions of healthcare professionals, more efficient healthcare systems, and more. This aligns with the theoretical framework, showing the relationship between systemic availability and individual capability which negatively affect a patient’s and a healthcare worker’s journey.
journal: Journal of Biomedical Advancement Scientific Research

abstract_zh: 登革热是一种困扰菲律宾的疾病,菲律宾黎刹省(Rizal)公共医院中登革热患者和医护人员在应对登革热病例上升时的经历仍需进一步研究。本研究通过采访黎刹省公共医院的医疗专业人员和登革热患者,收集信息以解读和考虑他们的经历,从而提高登革热病例治疗的有效性、效率和质量。本研究采用定性研究方法,通过滚雪球抽样获取了三名登革热患者和三名医护人员的半结构化访谈数据,并采用主题分析法对数据进行综合。研究发现,患者经历了由于人员不足、住宿困难以及疾病对其心理和身体健康造成的长期影响等问题。医护人员则因患者数量众多、与患者沟通困难以及设施不足而面临严重的工作负担。这揭示了各群体的经历以及黎刹省公共医院在医疗方面可能需要改进的方面,例如预算分配、建立更多三级医院、改善医护人员的工作条件、建立更高效的医疗系统等。这与理论框架相一致,展示了系统可用性与个人能力之间的关系,这种关系对患者和医护人员的就医过程产生负面影响。

title: Epidemiologia da dengue no Brasil, características gerais dessa doença tropical negligenciada e a vacinação como forma de prevenção
abstract: A dengue é uma arbovirose incluída na lista de doenças tropicais negligenciadas da Organização Mundial da Saúde, com impacto relevante para a saúde pública. O presente estudo teve como objetivo descrever os aspectos gerais da dengue, o uso da vacinação como forma de prevenção e apresentar a sua situação epidemiológica no Brasil. Trata-se de uma revisão narrativa da literatura, realizada a partir da busca de artigos publicados entre 2014 e 2025 nas bases de dados PubMed, LILACS e SciELO. O vírus da dengue (DENV) pertence ao gênero Flavivirus e possui quatro sorotipos distintos. A doença apresenta amplo espectro clínico, variando de formas assintomáticas a quadros graves e fatais. Em geral, é importante destacar o papel relevante do tratamento de suporte, das ações de controle vetorial e prevenção, do diagnóstico oportuno e da vacinação como estratégia complementar. Em relação a epidemiologia no Brasil, ressalta-se que em 2024 foram registrados 6,4 milhões de casos prováveis e mais de 5.000 óbitos, em cenário de circulação dos quatro sorotipos, com elevada carga e repercussões clínicas, sociais e econômicas. Experiências com a abordagem One Health (Saúde Única) reforçam a importância da integração entre dimensões humanas, ambientais e vetoriais no enfrentamento da doença. Por fim, evidencia-se que a dengue é uma condição complexa, exigindo manejo clínico adequado, vigilância sensível, controle vetorial, vacinação guiada por critérios epidemiológicos e adoção da abordagem One Health como eixos complementares para reduzir sua carga e orientar políticas sustentáveis.

analysis.summary_en: This study provides an overview of dengue in Brazil, emphasizing its status as a neglected tropical disease and the role of vaccination in prevention. It outlines the general characteristics of dengue, including its classification as a Flavivirus with four distinct serotypes. The research highlights the wide clinical spectrum of the disease, ranging from asymptomatic cases to severe and fatal outcomes. The authors stress the importance of supportive treatment, vector control, timely diagnosis, and vaccination as complementary strategies. They also note the significant epidemiological burden in Brazil in 2024, with over 6.4 million probable cases and more than 5,000 deaths. The study advocates for the integration of human, environmental, and vector dimensions through the One Health approach to reduce the disease's impact. However, the findings are based on a literature review and do not include detailed statistical or methodological analysis.

title: Shared Learning for Nationwide Municipal Dengue Incidence Forecasting in Brazil: Evidence on History, Climate, and Model Trade-Offs
abstract: Municipality-level dengue forecasting is challenging because each time series is short. Additional predictors also do not always provide useful information. We evaluated one-month-ahead monthly incidence across all 5,570 Brazilian municipalities. The evaluation used 60 rolling targets and history windows of 12–48 months. We first used a 50-municipality diagnostic sample to test history, shared versus local learning, additional information, and neural models. We then conducted nationwide internal validation. In the diagnostic sample, the shared gated recurrent unit (GRU) reduced pooled MAE by 23.0%–24.5% compared with municipality-specific GRUs. Climate improved local LightGBM (MAE, 3.9%–5.1%; RMSE, 10.3%–11.5%). However, climate increased the shared GRU’s MAE. The predictive value of climate therefore depended on the model. Nationwide, the history-only shared GRU had the lowest RMSE at every lookback. An adaptive ensemble slightly improved MAE but increased RMSE.
